Level 1 · the big picture

The Pi harness, as one event model

Durable preparation approval, the regeneration cycle's stage facts, and measurement records for session-agnostic ORC regeneration cycles. One bounded context, specified in three layers; ORC's :sheet blocks are the facts it dispatches and projects. Open the context for its aggregates, one per Allium file.

Each part is specified in three layers

behaviourAllium.pi/model/*.allium: one file per aggregate. Its state and lifecycle, the rules that change it (when · requires · ensures), invariants, and the surfaces that say who may act.
topologyEvent Model.pi/model/event-model/**/event_model.clj: Grain's defeventmodel blocks (commands, events with schemas, read models, queries, policies) and the flows that join them. Each block links back to its Allium rule.
examplesGherkinplan/NN-slug/spec.feature and drafts.feature: Given/When/Then, each scenario stamped @item-NN-SSS with its build tier, and tagged @allium-… with the obligations it checks. A rule's success and each of its refusals is one obligation.

Components (C4 level 3)

flowchart TB
  operator(["<b>Operator / driver</b><br/>[Person, external system]"])

  subgraph p ["Harness process [Container]"]
    seam["<b>Seam</b><br/>[Component: JSON-RPC over stdio]<br/>Maps each of 16 actions to a command or query; refuses with a named reason"]
    control["<b>Harness commands</b><br/>[Component: Grain defcommand]<br/>Operator intents: selections, preparations, submissions, checklists, grader approval. Stage facts from ORC's nodes: self-check, clean room, slices, candidate, gate, authored and calibrated graders. System facts from policies"]
    views["<b>Projections and queries</b><br/>[Component: Grain defreadmodel, defquery]<br/>Cycles, selections, preparations, receipts, outcomes, cuts, gate attempts, graders, measurements, scoreboards, builder sessions; node-stages translates ORC"]
    dispatch["<b>Policies</b><br/>[Component: Grain defprocessor]<br/>One ORC tick per task-submitted; receipts and outcomes; start the cycle; route the gate verdict and the score; report the scoreboard; conclude the cycle; file the score; record evidence; bind workspace generations; retire replaced graders"]
    launcher["<b>Builder launcher</b><br/>[Component: Grain defprocessor launch-builder-for-tick]<br/>Launches, or relaunches, the durable session of each builder tick in the room ORC chose"]
    workflow["<b>Cycle workflow</b><br/>[Component: ORC sheet]<br/>fence, regenerate, gate, score, scoreboard; continuation, verification repair, durable resume"]
    strategy["<b>Instruction strategy</b><br/>[Component: ORC, GEPA]<br/>Renders every production prompt; optimizes builder instructions per purpose"]
    instrument["<b>Instrument</b><br/>[Component: approved sealed graders]<br/>Checklist, one verdict per item, scoreboard"]
    guard["<b>Event Model guard</b><br/>[Component: Grain verify-or-throw!]<br/>Refuses to start on any drift from the registered model"]
  end

  events[("<b>Event store</b><br/>[Container: Grain]")]
  rooms["<b>Builder, gate, validation rooms</b><br/>[Containers: Gondolin VMs]"]
  host["<b>Builder host</b><br/>[Container: pi-durable, provided]"]

From .pi/architecture.md, Level 3: Component (harness process).

Policies, timers, read models and queries, with their descriptions14 policies · 16 read models
builder-tool-result-committedbuilder-sessionto-do→bind-committed-resultpolicy→bind-workspace-generation

When the builder host commits a tool result, bind the workspace generation it left to it.

scoreboard-reportedscoreboardto-do→close-reported-cyclepolicy→advance-cycle-stage

When a cycle's scoreboard is reported, move the cycle to its result.

cycle-stage-advancedregeneration-cycleto-do→conclude-cycle-resultpolicy→conclude-cycle

When a cycle reaches its result, derive its terminal status from its one measurement.

task-submittedtask-receiptto-do→dispatch-submitted-taskpolicy→sheet · tick-tree

Dispatch each submitted task through ORC's Grain command boundary exactly once.

sheet · node-execution-completedapproved-gradersto-docycle-preparationto-donode-stageto-do→file-cycle-scorepolicy→file-score

When the translation names a completed node the score stage of a cycle, file the sealed grader's returned verdicts.

sheet · tree-tick-startedtask-receiptto-do→issue-task-receiptpolicy→record-task-receipt

When ORC starts the tick dispatched for a submitted task, bind the task to that tick.

sheet · node-execution-startedbuilder-sessionto-donode-stageto-do→launch-builder-for-tickpolicy→launch-builder-sessionrelaunch-builder-session

When ORC starts a node the translation names a builder role, launch its durable Pi session; when ORC resumes it, relaunch the same session.

sheet · tick-cancelledsheet · tree-tick-completedtick-taskto-do→record-task-outcomepolicy→complete-taskfail-task

When ORC completes or cancels a task's tick, record the task's one terminal outcome.

sheet · node-execution-completednode-stageto-do→record-validation-evidencepolicy→record-observation

When the translation names a completed node an independent validation step, record its observations.

cycle-stage-advancedcycle-measurementto-doregeneration-cycleto-do→report-cycle-scoreboardpolicy→report-scoreboard

When a cycle reaches the scoreboard, report its scoreboard against the previous measurement of the same selection.

grader-approvedgraderto-do→retire-replaced-graderpolicy→retire-grader

When an operator approves a grader that replaces another, retire the one it replaces.

cycle-measurement-recordedscore-refusedcycle-measurementto-do→route-filed-scorepolicy→advance-cycle-stagefail-cycle-stage

Route a score: a filed measurement moves the cycle to the scoreboard; a refused score fails the score stage.

gate-attempt-recordedgate-attemptto-do→route-gate-verdictpolicy→advance-cycle-stagefail-cycle-stage

Route a recorded gate attempt: a pass moves the cycle to the score; a failure under three attempts back to regenerate; a third failure fails the gate stage.

task-receipt-issuedregeneration-cycleto-do→start-dispatched-cyclepolicy→start-cycle

When a cycle's task is bound to its ORC tick, start the submitted cycle at the fence.

builder-intervention-recordedbuilder-session-endedbuilder-session-launchedbuilder-session-resumedbuilder-tool-result-committedworkspace-generation-bound→builder-sessionsread model→builder-sessionquery

Builder sessions: each ORC builder tick's durable session, builder room, status, launches, interventions, and workspace generations.

checklist-derived→checklistsread model→checklistquery

Derived checklists by selection.

cycle-measurement-recordedscore-refused→cycle-measurementsread model→cycle-measurementquery

Durable measurement receipts keyed by cycle identity: a projection of the one filed measurement, or of the refusal that filed none.

baseline-trace-boundobservation-recordedvalidation-room-opened→cycle-observationsread model→cycle-observationsquery

Evidence grouped by cycle, item, kind, and producer, with each cycle's validation room and bound baseline trace.

cycle-preparation-approvedcycle-preparation-recorded→cycle-preparationsread model→cycle-preparationquery

Complete reviewed cycle preparations with approval status.

gate-attempt-recorded→gate-attemptsread model→gate-attemptquery

Every gate attempt of every cycle, by cycle and attempt.

grader-approvedgrader-authoredgrader-authoring-requestedgrader-discardedgrader-recalibration-requestedgrader-replacedgrader-sealedinstrument-declared-unavailable→gradersread model→approved-gradersquerygraderquery

Graders by digest and status (calibrating, sealed, approved, replaced, discarded), the authoring and recalibration requests, and the scenarios with no instrument.

harness-self-check-recorded→harness-self-checksread model→

Harness self-checks by harness digest; a passing one is reused only for an identical digest.

sheet · node-execution-completedsheet · node-execution-startedsheet · tick-cancelledsheet · tree-tick-completedsheet · tree-tick-started→node-stagesread model→cycle-progressquerynode-stagequery

The anti-corruption translation of ORC's execution facts: for each tick and node, the harness's CycleStage and builder role, and each tick's latest stage and status. Processors and the progress view read this, never a raw node id.

cut-prepared→prepared-cutsread model→slice-compositionquery

Prepared cuts and their slice composition.

instruction-candidate-measuredinstruction-candidate-proposedinstruction-candidate-rejectedproduction-prompt-renderedprompt-optimization-failedprompt-optimization-startedwinning-instruction-selected→prompt-optimizationsread model→prompt-optimizationquery

Builder-instruction optimizations, their production prompts, candidates, measurements, and winning instructions.

candidate-regeneratedchild-cycle-lineage-recordedclean-room-provedcycle-failedcycle-passedcycle-stage-advancedcycle-startedcycle-submittedslice-builttask-receipt-issued→regeneration-cyclesread model→regeneration-cyclequery

The regeneration cycle read model: each cycle's status, stage, slice builds, candidate, failure, and child lineage, folded from the harness's own cycle facts.

scoreboard-reported→scoreboardsread model→scoreboardquery

Reported scoreboards by cycle.

selection-approvedselection-recorded→selectionsread model→selectionquery

Recorded selections with approval status.

task-completedtask-failedtask-receipt-issued→task-outcomesread model→task-outcomequery

Each task's status and, once terminal, its one stable outcome.

Submitted tasks, their request identities, and the ORC ticks they name.

A source-cut task is submitted and dispatched to ORC once; ORC's cut workflow records the prepared cut, whose slice composition is read back.

The harness half of the cycle, which feeds the build loop: ORC's fence node records the self-check and proves the clean room; its regenerate node records each slice build and the candidate; its gate node records the gate attempt, and a policy routes the verdict to the score, back to regenerate, or to a failed gate after three attempts.

The instrument half of the cycle, which reports to a person and never feeds the loop: when the translation names ORC's score node completed, a processor files the sealed grader's verdicts; a policy moves a filed measurement to the scoreboard or fails a refused score; the scoreboard is reported; and the result policy makes the cycle passed or failed.

ORC starts a node the translation names a builder role; its durable Pi session is launched once in the builder room ORC chose (or the same session relaunched), the builder host commits tool results, each is bound to its workspace generation, the host reports the session's end, and an operator observes the session read-only or intervenes.

An operator derives a selection's checklist and asks for its grader: an approved grader that covers it is recalibrated, otherwise a grader author is requested; ORC's grader-author node records the authored grader; its calibration node seals a calibrated grader or discards an uncalibrated one (re-authoring it, or declaring the instrument unavailable after three); the operator approves a sealed grader's exact digest, and a policy retires the grader it replaces.

The boundary: what holds everywhere

The actors that may act (Operator, OrcRuntime), any contract every surface fulfils, and what others own.

CandidateBlindAuthor · A grader author reads no candidate, transcript, prior verdict, or host credential; its grader is a function of the selected Gherkin and the public calibration protocol alone.1 scenariocontract GraderAuthoring · @allium-boundary.CandidateBlindAuthor
@item-03-002@balance@allium-invariant.GraderAuthorRoomHoldsOnlySpecAndProtocol@allium-rule-success.RequestGraderAuthoring@allium-rule-success.AuthorGrader@allium-rule-success.SealCalibratedGrader@allium-rule-failure.SealCalibratedGrader.3@allium-rule-failure.SealCalibratedGrader.4@allium-rule-success.ReauthorUncalibratedGrader@allium-rule-failure.ReauthorUncalibratedGrader.2@allium-boundary.CandidateBlindAuthorbalance
Scenario: A grader is written once from the spec and calibrated before it is sealed
Given no sealed grader covers a checklist item's scenario digest
When an independent grader author derives a grader from only the selected Gherkin and the public calibration protocol
Then the author cannot read any candidate, builder or gate transcript, prior verdict, or host credential
And ORC calibrates the grader so carried behavior passes and uncarried behavior fails for every item
And an uncalibrated grader is discarded and re-authored from the failing calibration cases, at most three attempts
And only a calibrated grader is sealed under its scenario digests and offered for approval
.pi/model/plan/03-instrument/spec.feature:22 · Rule: The grader is a sealed, calibrated instrument, not a per-cycle guess
CompleteStrategy · A candidate's instruction is the complete model-directed strategy for its purpose. Runtime task context is rendered beside it, and no builder host appends strategy.1 scenariocontract ProductionPromptRendering · @allium-boundary.CompleteStrategy
@item-06-004@deferred@allium-boundary.CompleteStrategy@allium-guarantee.OrcOwnsCompleteProductionInstruction@allium-guarantee.ExactProductionPromptTransportdeferred
Scenario: GEPA optimizes the complete strategy sent through one prompt seam
Given ORC owns a complete model-directed strategy and deterministic runtime task context
When an instruction candidate is evaluated
Then ORC renders the exact candidate strategy beside the runtime task context
And the evaluated prompt digest equals the prompt digest received by the builder
And adapter code neither appends instructions nor constructs production prompt text
.pi/model/plan/06-prompt-optimization/spec.feature:32 · Rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
DeterministicSelection · Previewing the same cut, project, slice, and items again yields the same selection identity and digest; any other choice yields a different digest.1 scenariocontract SelectionResolution · @allium-boundary.DeterministicSelection
@e2e@item-01-005@balance@allium-rule-success.PreviewSelection@allium-boundary.DeterministicSelectionbalance
Scenario: Previewing the same slice produces the same selection identity
Given the same pinned cut, project, slice, and requested item subset
And the selection has not already been approved
When the selection is previewed more than once
Then each preview contains the same ordered item denominator
And each preview has the same selection identity and digest
And its status is awaiting approval
.pi/model/plan/01-regeneration-cycle/spec.feature:48 · Rule: Selection is deterministic and approval binds the reviewed identity
DeterministicPreparation · Preparing the same choices again yields the same preparation identity and digest; changing any bound choice is a new preparation.1 scenariocontract PreparationBinding · @allium-boundary.DeterministicPreparation
@item-04-011@deferred@allium-rule-success.PrepareCycle@allium-rule-success.ApprovePreparation@allium-rule-failure.ApprovePreparation.2@allium-boundary.DeterministicPreparation@allium-invariant.ApprovedPreparationDigestIsStabledeferred
Scenario: Approval binds the complete cycle preparation and diagram
Given an approved slice selection
When an operator session prepares a cycle with scope, target stack, execution profile, pinned inputs, and outer-cycle budget
Then the harness returns a deterministic preparation diagram and digest
And approval accepts only that exact preparation digest
And changing any bound field requires a new preparation
.pi/model/plan/04-operator-control-plane/spec.feature:92 · Rule: The reviewed preparation binds every cycle-defining choice

Level 3 · aggregate in Pi harness context

Execution pipeline

Scope: the regeneration cycle in the legacy shape: fence, regenerate, gate, score, scoreboard. The fence and the gate are the harness and feed the build loop. The score and the scoreboard are the instrument (instrument.allium) and never feed the loop. The file is named for its slice, 02-execution-pipeline; the concept is the regeneration cycle. Includes: the rules that move the one cycle aggregate (regeneration-cycle.allium RegenerationCycle) through its stages to a terminal status, the harness self-check, the clean room, one builder per slice, the one builder session aggregate (BuilderSession), launched by ORC in builder rooms it chooses, gate attempts and repair, and the candidate subject. Excludes: the cycle aggregate itself and operator approval (regeneration-cycle.allium), grader authoring, score filing, and the scoreboard (instrument.allium, which owns the measurement), runtime evidence (runtime-evidence.allium), and Grain command/event plumbing.

rule RunHarnessSelfCheck {
    when: HarnessSelfCheckRan(orc, harness_digest, golden_digests, failing_checks)
    requires: golden_digests.count > 0
    ensures: HarnessSelfCheck.created(
        harness_digest: harness_digest,
        golden_digests: golden_digests,
        passed: failing_checks.count = 0,
        failing_checks: failing_checks
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/execution-pipeline.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule FenceCleanRoom {
    when: CleanRoomProved(orc, cycle, cut_digest, fenced_paths, harness_digest)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = fence
    requires: exists HarnessSelfCheck{harness_digest: harness_digest, passed: true}
    requires: approved_grader_covers(cycle.preparation.grader_digest, cycle.preparation.selection.items)
    requires: fenced_paths.count > 0
    requires: every_fenced_path_matches(cut_digest, fenced_paths)
    ensures: CleanRoom.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        cut_digest: cut_digest,
        fenced_paths: fenced_paths,
        single_root_commit: true,
        fenced_paths_unreachable: true
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = regenerate
}

rule RegenerateCandidate {
    when: BuilderCompleted(orc, cycle, attempt, builder_session, subject_digest,
                           generated_paths, tool_calls)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = regenerate
    requires: attempt >= 1
    requires: attempt <= 3
    requires: builder_session.cycle = cycle
    requires: builder_session.attempt = attempt
    requires: builder_session.role != grader_author
    requires: generated_paths.count > 0
    requires: tool_calls > 0
    requires: attempt > 1 implies builder_inputs_are_previous_candidate_and_gate_evidence(cycle, attempt)
    requires: attempt = 1 implies completed_slice_builds(cycle) = selected_slice_count(cycle)
    ensures: CandidateSubject.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        attempt: attempt,
        digest: subject_digest,
        generated_paths: generated_paths,
        tool_calls: tool_calls
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = gate
}

rule BuildSlice {
    when: SliceBuilderCompleted(orc, cycle, slice, position, builder_session, generated_paths)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = regenerate
    requires: builder_session.cycle = cycle
    requires: builder_session.role = slice_builder
    requires: position = selected_slice_position(cycle, slice)
    requires: completed_slice_builds(cycle) = position - 1
    requires: slice_builder_inputs_are_clean_room_and_cycle_candidate(cycle, slice)
    requires: generated_paths.count > 0
    ensures: SliceBuild.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        slice: slice,
        position: position,
        builder_session: builder_session,
        generated_paths: generated_paths
    )
}

Scenario: A builder session is keyed by its ORC tick and resumes rather than restarts
Given ORC starts a tick for a slice builder, a repair builder, or a grader author
When ORC launches that tick's builder session
Then the session is a durable Pi session identified by the tick
And a relaunch of the same tick after a crash resumes that session from its committed turns

Source: .pi/model/execution-pipeline.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule LaunchDurableBuilderSession {
    when: BuilderTickStarted(orc, tick_identity, cycle, attempt, role, room, production_prompt_digest)
    requires: not exists BuilderSession{tick_identity: tick_identity}
    requires: room.cut_read_only
    requires: not room.egress_allowed
    requires: not room.inherits_host_environment
    requires: room.writable_scope.count > 0 or role = grader_author
    requires: role = repair_builder implies room.evidence_root != null
    requires: role != repair_builder implies room.evidence_root = null
    requires: role = grader_author implies cycle = null
    requires: role != grader_author implies cycle != null and attempt != null
    ensures: BuilderSession.created(
        tick_identity: tick_identity,
        role: role,
        session_identity: durable_session_for(tick_identity),
        cycle: cycle,
        attempt: attempt,
        room: room,
        production_prompt_digest: production_prompt_digest,
        status: running,
        launches: 1,
        assisted: false,
        last_intervention: null
    )
}

rule FailCycleStage {
    when: CycleStageDidNotSucceed(cycle, stage, failure_kind, reason)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = stage
    ensures: cycle.status = failed
    ensures: cycle.failure_stage = stage
    ensures: cycle.failure_kind = failure_kind
    ensures: cycle.failure_reason = reason
    ensures: FailedDenominatorPreserved(cycle: cycle, item_identities: cycle.preparation.selection.items)
}

            attempt.fresh_state_root and
            attempt.answered_by_booted_candidate
}

Level 3 · aggregate in Pi harness context

Instrument

Scope: the instrument: a checklist derived from the spec, a grader written once by a grader author, calibrated, sealed, and approved by digest, a score with an honest denominator, and a scoreboard that compares cycles on shared items in both directions. It reports to a person and never feeds the build loop. Includes: stamping, checklist derivation, grader authoring, calibration, sealing, approval, reuse and replacement, score filing into the one measurement aggregate (CycleMeasurement), its refusals, and scoreboard comparison. Excludes: the grader's own test logic, building candidates, the gate, the grader author's builder session (execution-pipeline.allium BuilderSession), and ORC's evaluation judges (ORC specs/evaluation.allium): their scores are diagnostic runtime evidence (runtime-evidence.allium), never a verdict. ORC runs the sealed grader as a bounded step of the score stage; the rules below, not ORC, file its verdicts.

entity Grader {
    digest: String
    scenario_digests: List<String>
    author_session_identity: String
    attempt: Integer
    status: GraderStatus
    replaces: Grader?
    replacement_reason: GraderReplacementReason?

    transitions status {
        calibrating -> sealed
        calibrating -> discarded
        sealed -> approved
        approved -> replaced
        terminal: replaced, discarded
    }
}
entity CycleMeasurement {
    cycle: cycle/RegenerationCycle
    grader_digest: String
    total: Integer
    passed: Integer
    failed: Integer
    complete: Boolean
    items: List<ItemScore>
}

    selection: cycle/SliceSelection
    items: List<cycle/StampedItem>
}
entity StampedIdentity {
    slice_file: String
    identity: String
    sequence: Integer
}
entity InstrumentGolden {
    identity: String
    scenario_identity: String
    digest: String
    replaces: InstrumentGolden?
    replacement_reason: GraderReplacementReason?
}
entity Scoreboard {

    shared_items: List<String>

}

Given a slice whose highest stamped sequence number is 4 and one scenario with no item tag
When the slice is stamped

rule StampScenario {
    when: StampSliceScenario(operator, slice_file, scenario)
    requires: not scenario_has_item_tag(scenario)
    let sequence = highest_item_sequence_in_file(slice_file) + 1
    ensures: StampedIdentity.created(
        slice_file: slice_file,
        identity: item_identity(slice_file, sequence),
        sequence: sequence
    )
    ensures: ItemTagWritten(scenario: scenario, indentation: scenario_indentation(scenario))
}

@item-03-019@minimum@allium-rule-success.WriteInstrumentGolden@allium-guarantee.GoldensFromTheSpecminimum
Scenario: An instrument golden is written from a scenario, never recorded from an implementation
Given a scenario that fixes the instrument's exact behaviour, such as stamping, checklist derivation, a score refusal, or the scoreboard's arithmetic
When its golden is written
Then the golden states the scenario's inputs and its exact expected output, refusal reasons included
And it names the scenario it was written from
And it is never captured from any implementation's output
And it is instrument material, fenced from every clean room like a grader
.pi/model/plan/03-instrument/spec.feature:182 · Rule: The instrument's exact behaviour is held by goldens written from the spec
Source: .pi/model/instrument.allium
rule WriteInstrumentGolden {
    when: RecordInstrumentGolden(operator, identity, scenario_identity, digest, replaces, replacement_reason)
    requires: scenario_fixes_exact_instrument_behaviour(scenario_identity)
    requires: written_from_scenario_not_captured(identity)
    requires: replaces = null or replacement_reason != null
    requires: replacement_reason = spec_grew implies only_adds_cases(replaces, identity)
    ensures: InstrumentGolden.created(
        identity: identity,
        scenario_identity: scenario_identity,
        digest: digest,
        replaces: replaces,
        replacement_reason: replacement_reason
    )
}

rule DeriveChecklist {
    when: DeriveSelectionChecklist(operator, selection, scenarios)
    requires: scenarios.count > 0
    requires: every_scenario_has_stamped_identity(scenarios)
    requires: selection.status = approved
    ensures: Checklist.created(
        selection: selection,
        items: ordered_by_file_then_position(one_item_per_titled_scenario(scenarios))
    )
}

        attempt: 1,

    requires: grader.replacement_reason = spec_grew implies
              only_adds_items(grader.replaces, grader)
    ensures: grader.status = approved
}

Given a checklist of three items

Source: .pi/model/instrument.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule FileScore {
    when: ScoreReturned(orc, cycle, grader, checklist, verdicts)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = score
    requires: grader.status = approved
    requires: grader.digest = cycle.preparation.grader_digest
    requires: verdicts.count > 0
    requires: every_verdict_names_a_checklist_item(verdicts, checklist)
    requires: every_verdict_is_pass_or_fail(verdicts)
    let items = one_score_per_checklist_item(checklist, verdicts)
    ensures: CycleMeasurement.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        grader_digest: grader.digest,
        total: checklist.items.count,
        passed: items.count(item => item.verdict = pass),
        failed: items.count(item => item.verdict = fail),
        complete: items.all(item => item.reached),
        items: items
    )
}

Level 3 · aggregate in Pi harness context

Operator control plane

Scope: observable, session-agnostic control-plane behaviour: how an operator submits, waits for, and observes regeneration work. ORC owns task execution events. Includes: workflow tasks and receipts, dispatch to ORC, task lifecycle, cycle progress projected from ORC facts, builder session observation and intervention, child cycles, and reads of the durable measurement. Excludes: cuts, selections, preparations, cycles and submission idempotence (regeneration-cycle.allium, imported as cycle), ORC's own execution semantics (ORC specs/orc-service.allium), the cycle's stages and builder sessions (execution-pipeline.allium, imported as execution), the measurement (instrument.allium, imported as instrument), and the seam (affordances.yaml). A WorkflowTask is not a cycle: a task may prepare a cut. Builder session views and measurement receipts are read-side projections (the Grain read models builder-sessions and cycle-measurements) of BuilderSession and CycleMeasurement, never authorities, so they are not declared here.

entity WorkflowTask {
    identity: String
    kind: WorkflowTaskKind
    request_identity: String
    request_digest: String
    status: WorkflowTaskStatus
    trace_identity: String?
    outcome: String?
    preparation_identity: String?
    parent_cycle_identity: String?

    transitions status {
        submitted -> running
        running -> completed
        running -> failed
        terminal: completed, failed
    }
}
entity CycleProgressView {
    cycle_identity: String
    trace_identity: String
    stage: cycle/CycleStage
    status: WorkflowTaskStatus
    builder_session_identity: String?
    durable_cursor: String?
}

    requires: task.trace_identity != null
    ensures: CycleProgressView.created(
        cycle_identity: task.request_identity,
        trace_identity: task.trace_identity,
        stage: stage,
        status: status,
        builder_session_identity: builder_session_identity,
        durable_cursor: durable_cursor
    )
}

Level 3 · aggregate in Pi harness context

Prompt optimization

Scope: ORC-owned optimization of complete builder strategies through independent, purpose-specific regeneration measurements. Includes: production prompt rendering, builder instructions, reflection model binding, instruction candidates, their measurement, rejection, and selection. Excludes: GEPA's search algorithm (ORC specs/gepa.allium) and provider transport. The purposes are the seam's values (fresh-generation, verification-repair); each production prompt is rendered for one builder session role (execution-pipeline.allium BuilderSessionRole): a slice builder carries the fresh-generation instruction, a repair builder the verification-repair instruction, and a grader author ORC's own instruction.

Allium source.pi/model/prompt-optimization.allium
entity ProductionPrompt {
    identity: String
    role: execution/BuilderSessionRole
    system_instruction_digest: String
    task_instruction_digest: String
    runtime_task_context_digest: String
    digest: String
}
entity PromptOptimization {
    identity: String
    purpose: BuilderInstructionPurpose
    status: PromptOptimizationStatus
    reflection: ReflectionModelBinding
    training_examples: List<String>
    validation_examples: List<String>
    winning_instruction: BuilderInstruction?

    transitions status {
        evaluating -> optimized
        evaluating -> failed
        terminal: optimized, failed
    }
}
entity InstructionCandidate {
    identity: String
    optimization: PromptOptimization
    instruction: BuilderInstruction
    status: InstructionCandidateStatus
    proposal_call_digest: String
    production_prompt_digest: String?
    independent_score: Decimal?
    metric_evidence: String?

    transitions status {
        proposed -> measured
        proposed -> rejected
        measured -> selected
        measured -> rejected
        selected -> superseded
        terminal: rejected, superseded
    }
}

}

rule StartPromptOptimization {
    when: OptimizeBuilderInstruction(
        operator,
        optimization_identity,
        purpose,
        reflection_provider,
        reflection_model,
        training_examples,
        validation_examples
    )
    requires: reflection_provider = config.reflection_provider
    requires: reflection_model != ""
    requires: training_examples.count > 0
    requires: validation_examples.count > 0
    ensures: PromptOptimization.created(
        identity: optimization_identity,
        purpose: purpose,
        status: evaluating,
        reflection: ReflectionModelBinding{
            provider: reflection_provider,
            model: reflection_model
        },
        training_examples: training_examples,
        validation_examples: validation_examples,
        winning_instruction: null
    )
}

Scenario: An instruction candidate is measured under the exact production prompt it ran with
Given ORC proposed an instruction candidate for fresh generation
And ORC rendered a slice builder's production prompt whose task instruction is that candidate's builder instruction
And the builder host transported that production prompt unchanged
When ORC returns an independent metric from a fresh approved cut, with the fresh builder's gate result and a complete black-box grade
Then the instruction candidate is measured
And it records that production prompt's digest, the independent score, and the metric evidence
.pi/model/plan/06-prompt-optimization/drafts.feature:141
Source: .pi/model/prompt-optimization.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule MeasureInstructionCandidate {
    when: IndependentBuilderInstructionMetricReturned(
        orc,
        candidate,
        production_prompt,
        score,
        evidence
    )
    requires: candidate.status = proposed
    requires: (candidate.instruction.purpose = fresh_generation and production_prompt.role = slice_builder) or
              (candidate.instruction.purpose = verification_repair and production_prompt.role = repair_builder)
    requires: production_prompt.task_instruction_digest = candidate.instruction.text_digest
    requires: builder_host_transported_production_prompt_unchanged(production_prompt.digest)
    requires: purpose_specific_independent_measurement(
        candidate.instruction.purpose,
        evidence
    )
    requires: evidence_includes_fresh_builder_gate_and_complete_black_box_grade(evidence)
    ensures: candidate.status = measured
    ensures: candidate.production_prompt_digest = production_prompt.digest
    ensures: candidate.independent_score = score
    ensures: candidate.metric_evidence = evidence
}

@item-06-003 · Only the winning instruction for each purpose becomes durably active deferred
@item-06-003@deferred@allium-rule-success.SelectWinningInstruction@allium-invariant.OneActiveInstructionPerPurpose@allium-guarantee.DurableInstructionActivationdeferred
Scenario: Only the winning instruction for each purpose becomes durably active
Given prompt optimization evaluated one or more instruction candidates for one purpose
When optimization completes
Then the result identifies the winning instruction and its independent score
And ORC durably deactivates the prior instruction for that purpose
And subsequent cycles recover the selected instruction after process restart
.pi/model/plan/06-prompt-optimization/spec.feature:24 · Rule: Prompt optimization is independently measured
Source: .pi/model/prompt-optimization.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule SelectWinningInstruction {
    when: InstructionWinnerSelected(orc, optimization, winner)
    requires: optimization.status = evaluating
    requires: winner.optimization = optimization
    requires: winner.status = measured
    requires: winner.instruction.purpose = optimization.purpose
    requires: winner.independent_score = highest_measured_score(optimization)
    let prior = selected_candidate_for(optimization.purpose)
    ensures:
        winner.status = selected
        if prior != null:
            prior.status = superseded
    ensures: optimization.winning_instruction = winner.instruction
    ensures: optimization.status = optimized
    ensures: InstructionActivated(
        purpose: optimization.purpose,
        instruction_identity: winner.instruction.identity,
        text_digest: winner.instruction.text_digest
    )
}

Invariants and guarantees

What always holds (invariant), and what a surface promises (@guarantee).

ActiveInstructionWasIndependentlyMeasureddraftinvariant · @allium-invariant.ActiveInstructionWasIndependentlyMeasured
invariant ActiveInstructionWasIndependentlyMeasured {
    for candidate in InstructionCandidates:
        (candidate.status = selected or candidate.status = superseded) implies
            candidate.independent_score != null and
            candidate.production_prompt_digest != null and
            candidate.metric_evidence != null
}

OneActiveInstructionPerPurpose1 scenarioinvariant · @allium-invariant.OneActiveInstructionPerPurpose
invariant OneActiveInstructionPerPurpose {
    for candidate in InstructionCandidates:

            count(InstructionCandidates where status = selected and
                  instruction.purpose = candidate.instruction.purpose) = 1
}

Level 3 · aggregate in Pi harness context

Regeneration cycle

Scope: observable behaviour of the session-hosted ORC regeneration workflow. Product behaviour belongs to model/<project>; ORC runtime behaviour belongs to ORC. Includes: source cuts and their composed system view, slice selection and its approval by digest, cycle preparation and its approval, submission, and start; the one cycle aggregate, RegenerationCycle, with its status and stage; the stamped item a selection and a checklist carry; and the two actors, the operator and ORC's runtime. Excludes: the rules that move the cycle through its stages (execution-pipeline.allium), the instrument (instrument.allium), and ORC's runtime behaviour. The words are GLOSSARY.md's (ADR 0005). The seam's values (backend, profile) are used verbatim.

Allium source.pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium
entity OperatorSession {
    identity: String
}
entity OrcWorker {
    identity: String
}
entity SourceCut {
    identity: String
    source_commit: String
    tree_digest: String
    backend: ExecutionBackend
    fenced: Boolean
}
entity SliceSelection {
    identity: String
    digest: String
    status: SelectionStatus
    cut: SourceCut
    project_identity: String
    container_identity: String
    component_identity: String
    slice_identity: String
    items: List<StampedItem>

    transitions status {
        awaiting_approval -> approved
        terminal: approved
    }
}
entity SystemComposition {
    cut: SourceCut
    digest: String
    slice_mappings: List<String>
}
entity CyclePreparation {
    identity: String
    digest: String
    status: PreparationStatus
    selection: SliceSelection
    scope: CandidateScope
    target_stack: String
    execution_profile: ExecutionProfile
    cut_digest: String
    grader_digest: String
    diagram_digest: String
    max_outer_cycles: Integer

    transitions status {
        awaiting_approval -> approved
        terminal: approved
    }
}
entity RegenerationCycle {
    identity: String
    request_digest: String
    preparation: CyclePreparation
    parent_cycle_identity: String?
    status: CycleStatus
    stage: CycleStage
    candidate_digest: String?
    failure_stage: CycleStage?
    failure_kind: StageFailureKind?
    failure_reason: String?

    transitions status {
        submitted -> running
        running -> passed
        running -> failed
        terminal: passed, failed
    }

    transitions stage {
        fence -> regenerate
        regenerate -> gate
        gate -> regenerate
        gate -> score
        score -> scoreboard
        scoreboard -> result
        terminal: result
    }
}

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule ComposeCutSystemView {
    when: ComposeSystemView(operator, cut)
    requires: cut.fenced
    let slice_mappings = map_items_to_slices(cut)
    requires: every_item_mapped_exactly_once(cut, slice_mappings)
    requires: reduce_to_system_view(slice_mappings) = complete_system_view(cut)
    requires: decompose_system_view(complete_system_view(cut)) = slice_mappings
    ensures: SystemComposition.created(
        cut: cut,
        digest: composition_digest(cut, slice_mappings),
        slice_mappings: slice_mappings
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule PreviewSelection {
    when: PreviewSliceSelection(operator, cut, project_identity, slice_identity, requested_items)
    requires: cut.fenced
    requires: slice_identity in composed_slice_identities(cut)
    let resolved_items = resolve_items(cut, project_identity, slice_identity, requested_items)
    requires: resolved_items.count > 0
    ensures: SliceSelection.created(
        identity: selection_identity(cut, project_identity, slice_identity, resolved_items),
        digest: selection_digest(cut, project_identity, slice_identity, resolved_items),
        status: awaiting_approval,
        cut: cut,
        project_identity: project_identity,
        container_identity: container_for(cut, slice_identity),
        component_identity: component_for(cut, slice_identity),
        slice_identity: slice_identity,
        items: resolved_items
    )
}

rule ProposeSelectionFromIntent {
    when: ProposeSliceSelection(operator, cut, project_identity, operator_intent)
    requires: cut.fenced
    let proposed_slice_identity = proposed_slice(cut, project_identity, operator_intent)
    requires: proposed_slice_identity in composed_slice_identities(cut)

        identity: selection_identity(cut, project_identity, proposed_slice_identity, resolved_items),
        digest: selection_digest(cut, project_identity, proposed_slice_identity, resolved_items),
        status: awaiting_approval,
        cut: cut,
        project_identity: project_identity,
        container_identity: container_for(cut, proposed_slice_identity),
        component_identity: component_for(cut, proposed_slice_identity),
        slice_identity: proposed_slice_identity,
        items: resolved_items
    )
}

rule ApproveWholePlanBySubmission {
    when: SubmitWholePlanRegeneration(operator, request_identity, request_digest)
    let plan = whole_plan_preparation(pinned_cut())
    requires: plan.selection.items.count > 0
    requires: not exists RegenerationCycle{identity: request_identity}
    ensures:
        let preparation = CyclePreparation.created(
            identity: whole_plan_preparation_identity(pinned_cut()),
            digest: plan.digest,
            status: approved,
            selection: plan.selection,
            scope: plan.scope,
            target_stack: plan.target_stack,
            execution_profile: plan.execution_profile,
            cut_digest: plan.cut_digest,
            grader_digest: plan.grader_digest,
            diagram_digest: plan.diagram_digest,
            max_outer_cycles: 1
        )
        RegenerationCycle.created(
            identity: request_identity,
            preparation: preparation,
            request_digest: request_digest,
            parent_cycle_identity: null,
            status: submitted,
            stage: fence,
            candidate_digest: null,
            failure_stage: null,
            failure_kind: null,
            failure_reason: null
        )
}

Level 3 · aggregate in Pi harness context

Runtime evidence

Scope: a generic runtime-signal and independent-invariant evidence contract. Project models define what must be true; this model defines who may observe, evaluate, persist, and project claims about one regenerated candidate. Includes: runtime signals and their producers, independent invariant evaluations, capture policy, validation rooms and their cycle evidence volumes, baseline trace artifacts, and evidence projection. Excludes: what any one project must prove, telemetry transport details, and the technology that records signals and traces (.pi/architecture.md, "Technology bindings"). This spec is the one owner of EvidenceVerdict (an invariant evaluation may legitimately be inconclusive; a filed checklist verdict, instrument.allium ItemVerdict, may not), ProducerAuthority, EvidencePurpose, the EvidenceProjectionCreated fact, and the invariant EvidenceProjectionIsNotAuthority. Other specs import them with use.

Scenario: Candidate telemetry cannot author an independent verdict

Source: .pi/model/runtime-evidence.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule RecordRuntimeSignal {
    when: RuntimeSignalCaptured(orc, signal)
    requires: signal.identity != ""
    requires: signal.cycle_identity != ""
    requires: signal.producer != ""
    requires: signal.dropped_count >= 0
    ensures: RuntimeSignal.created(
        identity: signal.identity,
        cycle_identity: signal.cycle_identity,
        item_identity: signal.item_identity,
        operation_identity: signal.operation_identity,
        trace_identity: signal.trace_identity,
        event_identity: signal.event_identity,
        kind: signal.kind,
        producer: signal.producer,
        authority: signal.authority,
        purpose: signal.purpose,
        subject_digest: signal.subject_digest,
        content_digest: signal.content_digest,
        complete: signal.complete,
        sampled: signal.sampled,
        dropped_count: signal.dropped_count,
        collection_reason: signal.collection_reason
    )
}

Scenario: A passing invariant uses one correlated candidate subject
Given an accepted domain event and every required projection snapshot
And every signal names the same cycle, operation, event, aggregate, and subject digest
When the independent validator evaluates the named product invariant
Then it may record an evidence-backed passing observation
And the observation identifies every input artifact digest

Source: .pi/model/runtime-evidence.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule EvaluateCompleteInvariant {
    when: IndependentInvariantChecked(orc, cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity,
                                      producer, subject_digest, signals, verdict, evidence_digest)
    requires: signals.count > 0
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.cycle_identity = cycle_identity)
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.subject_digest = subject_digest)
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.complete)
    requires: signals.all(signal => not signal.sampled)
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.dropped_count = 0)
    requires: verdict = pass or verdict = fail
    ensures: IndependentInvariantEvaluation.created(
        identity: invariant_evaluation_identity(cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity),
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        item_identity: item_identity,
        invariant_identity: invariant_identity,
        producer: producer,
        authority: independent_validator,
        input_signals: signals,
        subject_digest: subject_digest,
        verdict: verdict,
        evidence_digest: evidence_digest
    )
}

    draft@allium-rule-failure.MarkIncompleteInvariantInconclusive.1
    draft · A complete collection cannot be marked inconclusive draft
    @draft@allium-rule-failure.MarkIncompleteInvariantInconclusive.1draft
    Scenario: A complete collection cannot be marked inconclusive
    Given ORC captured complete, unsampled runtime signals with nothing dropped for one cycle and subject digest
    When ORC reports the inputs of an independent invariant check over them as incomplete
    Then marking the independent invariant evaluation inconclusive is refused
    And no evidence verdict is recorded for that item and invariant
    .pi/model/plan/05-runtime-evidence/drafts.feature:142
  2. 2
    incomplete_collection_reason(signals) != ""
    draft@allium-rule-failure.MarkIncompleteInvariantInconclusive.2

    @draft@allium-rule-failure.MarkIncompleteInvariantInconclusive.2draft
    Scenario: An inconclusive evaluation must name the affected signal kind and reason
    Given ORC captured a sampled runtime signal whose collection completeness records no reason
    When ORC reports the inputs of an independent invariant check over it as incomplete
    Then marking the independent invariant evaluation inconclusive is refused
    And no evidence verdict is recorded for that item and invariant
    .pi/model/plan/05-runtime-evidence/drafts.feature:153

Examples
@item-05-003 · Missing or dropped required signals are inconclusive deferred
@item-05-003@deferred@allium-rule-success.MarkIncompleteInvariantInconclusive@allium-invariant.PassingEvaluationRequiresCompleteCollection@allium-invariant.DiagnosticSignalCannotDetermineVerdict@allium-guarantee.IncompleteMeansInconclusivedeferred
Scenario: Missing or dropped required signals are inconclusive
Given the sealed grader carries the generic evaluator for the runtime signals declared by the approved project model
And one required signal is missing, incomplete, sampled, or reported as dropped
When the score stage evaluates the captured evidence for an item
Then it persists an inconclusive invariant evaluation
And the approved item cannot pass the score
And collection status identifies the affected signal kind and reason
And diagnostic profiles remain available but cannot author a verdict
.pi/model/plan/05-runtime-evidence/spec.feature:25 · Rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
Source: .pi/model/runtime-evidence.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule MarkIncompleteInvariantInconclusive {
    when: IndependentInvariantInputsIncomplete(orc, cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity,
                                               producer, subject_digest, signals, evidence_digest)
    requires: signals.count = 0 or
        exists signals where not complete or sampled or dropped_count > 0
    requires: incomplete_collection_reason(signals) != ""
    ensures: IndependentInvariantEvaluation.created(
        identity: invariant_evaluation_identity(cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity),
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        item_identity: item_identity,
        invariant_identity: invariant_identity,
        producer: producer,
        authority: independent_validator,
        input_signals: signals,
        subject_digest: subject_digest,
        verdict: inconclusive,
        evidence_digest: evidence_digest
    )
}

@item-05-010 · Each comparison cycle isolates evidence from its pinned OTel capture policy deferred

Scenario: Each comparison cycle isolates evidence from its pinned OTel capture policy
Given the sealed harness snapshot supplies a declarative OTel capture policy
When an independent Gondolin validator room opens for one regeneration cycle
Then the candidate and OTel capture policy are mounted read-only
And the candidate subject digest remains unchanged after observation
And a fresh cycle evidence volume is the only writable grading mount
And the validator image supplies OBI and the OTel eBPF profiler with tracefs and BPF FS mounted
And native OTLP traces, metrics, and profiles are cycle-scoped diagnostic evidence
.pi/model/plan/05-runtime-evidence/spec.feature:84 · Rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
Source: .pi/model/runtime-evidence.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule OpenValidationRoom {
    when: ValidationRoomStarted(orc, cycle_identity, capture_policy, evidence_volume)
    requires: capture_policy.read_only
    requires: capture_policy.mount_path = config.capture_policy_mount
    requires: evidence_volume.cycle_identity = cycle_identity
    requires: evidence_volume.mount_path = config.evidence_volume_mount
    requires: evidence_volume.writable
    ensures: ValidationRoom.created(
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        capture_policy: capture_policy,
        evidence_volume: evidence_volume
    )
}

@item-05-001 · A score preserves its Playwright trace deferred

Scenario: A score preserves its Playwright trace
Given the sealed grader drives the candidate only through its public seam
When the score stage completes
Then the cycle evidence contains a non-empty Playwright trace archive

Source: .pi/model/runtime-evidence.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule BindSuccessfulBaselineTrace {
    when: BaselineGradeCompleted(orc, cycle_identity, evaluation, trace)
    requires: evaluation.verdict = pass
    requires: trace.cycle_identity = cycle_identity
    requires: trace.path = config.baseline_trace_path
    requires: trace.complete
    requires: trace.authority = independent_validator
    ensures: BaselineTraceBinding.created(
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        evidence_digest: evaluation.evidence_digest,
        trace: trace
    )
}

CandidateCannotAuthorIndependentVerdict1 scenarioinvariant · @allium-invariant.CandidateCannotAuthorIndependentVerdict
invariant CandidateCannotAuthorIndependentVerdict {
    for evaluation in IndependentInvariantEvaluations:
        evaluation.authority = independent_validator

@item-05-002@deferred@allium-rule-success.RecordRuntimeSignal@allium-invariant.CandidateCannotAuthorIndependentVerdict@allium-guarantee.IndependentVerdictAuthoritydeferred

PassingEvaluationRequiresCompleteCollection1 scenarioinvariant · @allium-invariant.PassingEvaluationRequiresCompleteCollection
invariant PassingEvaluationRequiresCompleteCollection {
    for evaluation in IndependentInvariantEvaluations:
        evaluation.verdict = pass implies
            evaluation.input_signals.count > 0 and
            evaluation.input_signals.all(signal =>
                signal.complete and not signal.sampled and signal.dropped_count = 0)
}

Level 3 · slice in Pi harness context

RPC seam

The harness's public seam is JSON-RPC over stdio. The harness is driven the same way by Pi, an operator, the gate, and a grader: one JSON object per line on stdin, one response per line on stdout, as declared in .pi/model/affordances.yaml.

No Allium file: this slice is specified only in Gherkin (.pi/model/plan/09-rpc-seam/spec.feature).

@item-02-018 · A builder session is keyed by its ORC tick and resumes rather than restarts balance
@item-02-018@balance@allium-rule-success.LaunchDurableBuilderSession@allium-rule-success.ResumeDurableBuilderSession@allium-invariant.DurableSessionIsKeyedByTickbalance
Scenario: A builder session is keyed by its ORC tick and resumes rather than restarts
Given ORC starts a tick for a slice builder, a repair builder, or a grader author
When ORC launches that tick's builder session
Then the session is a durable Pi session identified by the tick
And a relaunch of the same tick after a crash resumes that session from its committed turns
And a relaunch never starts a second session for the same tick
And the model credentials stay on the host and never enter the room
.pi/model/plan/02-execution-pipeline/spec.feature:164 · Rule: ORC launches every builder as a durable Pi session in a room ORC chooses
Source: .pi/model/execution-pipeline.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule LaunchDurableBuilderSession {
    when: BuilderTickStarted(orc, tick_identity, cycle, attempt, role, room, production_prompt_digest)
    requires: not exists BuilderSession{tick_identity: tick_identity}
    requires: room.cut_read_only
    requires: not room.egress_allowed
    requires: not room.inherits_host_environment
    requires: room.writable_scope.count > 0 or role = grader_author
    requires: role = repair_builder implies room.evidence_root != null
    requires: role != repair_builder implies room.evidence_root = null
    requires: role = grader_author implies cycle = null
    requires: role != grader_author implies cycle != null and attempt != null
    ensures: BuilderSession.created(
        tick_identity: tick_identity,
        role: role,
        session_identity: durable_session_for(tick_identity),
        cycle: cycle,
        attempt: attempt,
        room: room,
        production_prompt_digest: production_prompt_digest,
        status: running,
        launches: 1,
        assisted: false,
        last_intervention: null
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/prompt-optimization.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule MeasureInstructionCandidate {
    when: IndependentBuilderInstructionMetricReturned(
        orc,
        candidate,
        production_prompt,
        score,
        evidence
    )
    requires: candidate.status = proposed
    requires: (candidate.instruction.purpose = fresh_generation and production_prompt.role = slice_builder) or
              (candidate.instruction.purpose = verification_repair and production_prompt.role = repair_builder)
    requires: production_prompt.task_instruction_digest = candidate.instruction.text_digest
    requires: builder_host_transported_production_prompt_unchanged(production_prompt.digest)
    requires: purpose_specific_independent_measurement(
        candidate.instruction.purpose,
        evidence
    )
    requires: evidence_includes_fresh_builder_gate_and_complete_black_box_grade(evidence)
    ensures: candidate.status = measured
    ensures: candidate.production_prompt_digest = production_prompt.digest
    ensures: candidate.independent_score = score
    ensures: candidate.metric_evidence = evidence
}

Source: .pi/model/execution-pipeline.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule FenceCleanRoom {
    when: CleanRoomProved(orc, cycle, cut_digest, fenced_paths, harness_digest)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = fence
    requires: exists HarnessSelfCheck{harness_digest: harness_digest, passed: true}
    requires: approved_grader_covers(cycle.preparation.grader_digest, cycle.preparation.selection.items)
    requires: fenced_paths.count > 0
    requires: every_fenced_path_matches(cut_digest, fenced_paths)
    ensures: CleanRoom.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        cut_digest: cut_digest,
        fenced_paths: fenced_paths,
        single_root_commit: true,
        fenced_paths_unreachable: true
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = regenerate
}

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule PrepareCycle {
    when: PrepareRegenerationCycle(operator, preparation_identity, selection, scope,
                                   target_stack, execution_profile, cut_digest,
                                   grader_digest, diagram_digest, max_outer_cycles)
    requires: selection.status = approved
    requires: scope_is_safe(scope)
    requires: max_outer_cycles > 0
    ensures: CyclePreparation.created(
        identity: preparation_identity,
        digest: preparation_digest(
            selection, scope, target_stack, execution_profile, cut_digest,
            grader_digest, diagram_digest, max_outer_cycles),
        status: awaiting_approval,
        selection: selection,
        scope: scope,
        target_stack: target_stack,
        execution_profile: execution_profile,
        cut_digest: cut_digest,
        grader_digest: grader_digest,
        diagram_digest: diagram_digest,
        max_outer_cycles: max_outer_cycles
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule PreviewSelection {
    when: PreviewSliceSelection(operator, cut, project_identity, slice_identity, requested_items)
    requires: cut.fenced
    requires: slice_identity in composed_slice_identities(cut)
    let resolved_items = resolve_items(cut, project_identity, slice_identity, requested_items)
    requires: resolved_items.count > 0
    ensures: SliceSelection.created(
        identity: selection_identity(cut, project_identity, slice_identity, resolved_items),
        digest: selection_digest(cut, project_identity, slice_identity, resolved_items),
        status: awaiting_approval,
        cut: cut,
        project_identity: project_identity,
        container_identity: container_for(cut, slice_identity),
        component_identity: component_for(cut, slice_identity),
        slice_identity: slice_identity,
        items: resolved_items
    )
}

Given an operator describes the behavior to regenerate against a prepared cut
When an exploratory Pi, Codex, or other operator session inspects the cut composition and asks the LLM to propose a slice

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule ProposeSelectionFromIntent {
    when: ProposeSliceSelection(operator, cut, project_identity, operator_intent)
    requires: cut.fenced
    let proposed_slice_identity = proposed_slice(cut, project_identity, operator_intent)
    requires: proposed_slice_identity in composed_slice_identities(cut)
    let resolved_items = resolve_items(
        cut, project_identity, proposed_slice_identity,
        proposed_items(cut, project_identity, operator_intent))
    requires: resolved_items.count > 0
    ensures: SliceSelection.created(
        identity: selection_identity(cut, project_identity, proposed_slice_identity, resolved_items),
        digest: selection_digest(cut, project_identity, proposed_slice_identity, resolved_items),
        status: awaiting_approval,
        cut: cut,
        project_identity: project_identity,
        container_identity: container_for(cut, proposed_slice_identity),
        component_identity: component_for(cut, proposed_slice_identity),
        slice_identity: proposed_slice_identity,
        items: resolved_items
    )
}

Given a recorded measurement and the measurement of the previous cycle for the same selection
When the scoreboard is reported
Then it reports the pass rate of each cycle with its own denominator
And it restates the comparison on the items both cycles share
And it reports items that newly pass and items that newly fail separately, never as a net
And items new to the checklist are counted separately as the untuned holdout

rule ReportComparedScoreboard {
    when: scored: cycle/RegenerationCycle.stage becomes scoreboard
    requires: exists previous_measurement(scored)
    ensures: Scoreboard.created(
        cycle: scored,
        previous_cycle_identity: previous_measurement(scored),
        pass_rate: pass_rate(scored),
        denominator: denominator(scored),
        shared_items: shared_items(scored),
        newly_passing: newly_passing(scored),
        newly_failing: newly_failing(scored),
        new_items: new_items(scored),
        dropped_items: dropped_items(scored)
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/execution-pipeline.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule BuildSlice {
    when: SliceBuilderCompleted(orc, cycle, slice, position, builder_session, generated_paths)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = regenerate
    requires: builder_session.cycle = cycle
    requires: builder_session.role = slice_builder
    requires: position = selected_slice_position(cycle, slice)
    requires: completed_slice_builds(cycle) = position - 1
    requires: slice_builder_inputs_are_clean_room_and_cycle_candidate(cycle, slice)
    requires: generated_paths.count > 0
    ensures: SliceBuild.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        slice: slice,
        position: position,
        builder_session: builder_session,
        generated_paths: generated_paths
    )
}

Given a Codex, Pi, or other authorized operator session
When it supplies an immutable approved fixed execution contract through the public control plane

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule SubmitCycle {
    when: SubmitRegenerationCycle(operator, request_identity, request_digest, preparation, parent_cycle_identity, backend)
    requires: preparation.status = approved
    requires: fixed_bounded_execution_contract(preparation)
    requires: preparation.selection.items.count > 0
    requires: not exists RegenerationCycle{identity: request_identity}
    requires: preparation.execution_profile = automatic or
              (preparation.execution_profile = host_development and backend = host) or
              (preparation.execution_profile = gondolin_isolated and backend = gondolin)
    ensures: RegenerationCycle.created(
        identity: request_identity,
        request_digest: request_digest,
        preparation: preparation,
        parent_cycle_identity: parent_cycle_identity,
        status: submitted,
        stage: fence,
        candidate_digest: null,
        failure_stage: null,
        failure_kind: null,
        failure_reason: null
    )
}

rule ContinueWithChildCycle {
    when: PrepareChildCycle(operator_session, parent_task, child_preparation, reason)
    requires: parent_task.status = completed or parent_task.status = failed
    requires: child_preparation.status = approved
    requires: within_outer_cycle_budget(parent_task, child_preparation)
    ensures: ChildCycleLineageRecorded(
        parent_cycle_identity: parent_task.request_identity,
        preparation_identity: child_preparation.identity,
        reason: reason
    )
}

rule ResumeDurableBuilderSession {
    when: BuilderTickRelaunched(orc, builder_session, room, production_prompt_digest)
    requires: room = builder_session.room
    requires: production_prompt_digest = builder_session.production_prompt_digest
    requires: builder_session.status = running
    ensures: builder_session.launches = builder_session.launches + 1
}

rule OpenValidationRoom {
    when: ValidationRoomStarted(orc, cycle_identity, capture_policy, evidence_volume)
    requires: capture_policy.read_only
    requires: capture_policy.mount_path = config.capture_policy_mount
    requires: evidence_volume.cycle_identity = cycle_identity
    requires: evidence_volume.mount_path = config.evidence_volume_mount
    requires: evidence_volume.writable
    ensures: ValidationRoom.created(
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        capture_policy: capture_policy,
        evidence_volume: evidence_volume
    )
}

rule AuthorGrader {
    when: GraderAuthored(orc, grader_digest, scenario_digests, author_session_identity, attempt, replaces, replacement_reason)
    requires: not exists Grader{digest: grader_digest}
    requires: attempt >= 1
    requires: attempt <= 3
    requires: replaces = null or replacement_reason != null
    ensures: Grader.created(
        digest: grader_digest,
        scenario_digests: scenario_digests,
        author_session_identity: author_session_identity,
        attempt: attempt,
        status: calibrating,
        replaces: replaces,
        replacement_reason: replacement_reason
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/instrument.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule FileScore {
    when: ScoreReturned(orc, cycle, grader, checklist, verdicts)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = score
    requires: grader.status = approved
    requires: grader.digest = cycle.preparation.grader_digest
    requires: verdicts.count > 0
    requires: every_verdict_names_a_checklist_item(verdicts, checklist)
    requires: every_verdict_is_pass_or_fail(verdicts)
    let items = one_score_per_checklist_item(checklist, verdicts)
    ensures: CycleMeasurement.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        grader_digest: grader.digest,
        total: checklist.items.count,
        passed: items.count(item => item.verdict = pass),
        failed: items.count(item => item.verdict = fail),
        complete: items.all(item => item.reached),
        items: items
    )
}

Given a recorded measurement and the measurement of the previous cycle for the same selection
When the scoreboard is reported

    requires: exists previous_measurement(scored)

        previous_cycle_identity: previous_measurement(scored),
        pass_rate: pass_rate(scored),
        denominator: denominator(scored),
        shared_items: shared_items(scored),
        newly_passing: newly_passing(scored),
        newly_failing: newly_failing(scored),
        new_items: new_items(scored),
        dropped_items: dropped_items(scored)
    )
}

rule ApproveWholePlanBySubmission {
    when: SubmitWholePlanRegeneration(operator, request_identity, request_digest)
    let plan = whole_plan_preparation(pinned_cut())
    requires: plan.selection.items.count > 0
    requires: not exists RegenerationCycle{identity: request_identity}
    ensures:
        let preparation = CyclePreparation.created(
            identity: whole_plan_preparation_identity(pinned_cut()),
            digest: plan.digest,
            status: approved,
            selection: plan.selection,
            scope: plan.scope,
            target_stack: plan.target_stack,
            execution_profile: plan.execution_profile,
            cut_digest: plan.cut_digest,
            grader_digest: plan.grader_digest,
            diagram_digest: plan.diagram_digest,
            max_outer_cycles: 1
        )
        RegenerationCycle.created(
            identity: request_identity,
            preparation: preparation,
            request_digest: request_digest,
            parent_cycle_identity: null,
            status: submitted,
            stage: fence,
            candidate_digest: null,
            failure_stage: null,
            failure_kind: null,
            failure_reason: null
        )
}

Scenario: A grader is written once from the spec and calibrated before it is sealed
Given no sealed grader covers a checklist item's scenario digest
When an independent grader author derives a grader from only the selected Gherkin and the public calibration protocol
Then the author cannot read any candidate, builder or gate transcript, prior verdict, or host credential
And ORC calibrates the grader so carried behavior passes and uncarried behavior fails for every item
And an uncalibrated grader is discarded and re-authored from the failing calibration cases, at most three attempts
And only a calibrated grader is sealed under its scenario digests and offered for approval
.pi/model/plan/03-instrument/spec.feature:22 · Rule: The grader is a sealed, calibrated instrument, not a per-cycle guess
Source: .pi/model/instrument.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule AuthorGrader {
    when: GraderAuthored(orc, grader_digest, scenario_digests, author_session_identity, attempt, replaces, replacement_reason)
    requires: not exists Grader{digest: grader_digest}
    requires: attempt >= 1
    requires: attempt <= 3
    requires: replaces = null or replacement_reason != null
    ensures: Grader.created(
        digest: grader_digest,
        scenario_digests: scenario_digests,
        author_session_identity: author_session_identity,
        attempt: attempt,
        status: calibrating,
        replaces: replaces,
        replacement_reason: replacement_reason
    )
}

rule ProposeInstructionCandidate {
    when: InstructionProposed(
        orc,
        optimization,
        candidate_identity,
        instruction,
        reflection_provider,
        reflection_model,
        proposal_call_digest
    )
    requires: optimization.status = evaluating
    requires: instruction.purpose = optimization.purpose
    requires: reflection_provider = optimization.reflection.provider
    requires: reflection_model = optimization.reflection.model
    requires: proposal_call_digest != ""
    ensures: InstructionCandidate.created(
        identity: candidate_identity,
        optimization: optimization,
        instruction: instruction,
        status: proposed,
        proposal_call_digest: proposal_call_digest,
        production_prompt_digest: null,
        independent_score: null,
        metric_evidence: null
    )
}

Scenario: An unreached item is recorded as failed and the denominator holds
Given a checklist of three items

Source: .pi/model/instrument.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule FileScore {
    when: ScoreReturned(orc, cycle, grader, checklist, verdicts)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = score
    requires: grader.status = approved
    requires: grader.digest = cycle.preparation.grader_digest
    requires: verdicts.count > 0
    requires: every_verdict_names_a_checklist_item(verdicts, checklist)
    requires: every_verdict_is_pass_or_fail(verdicts)
    let items = one_score_per_checklist_item(checklist, verdicts)
    ensures: CycleMeasurement.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        grader_digest: grader.digest,
        total: checklist.items.count,
        passed: items.count(item => item.verdict = pass),
        failed: items.count(item => item.verdict = fail),
        complete: items.all(item => item.reached),
        items: items
    )
}

rule DeriveChecklist {
    when: DeriveSelectionChecklist(operator, selection, scenarios)
    requires: scenarios.count > 0
    requires: every_scenario_has_stamped_identity(scenarios)
    requires: selection.status = approved
    ensures: Checklist.created(
        selection: selection,
        items: ordered_by_file_then_position(one_item_per_titled_scenario(scenarios))
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/runtime-evidence.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule RecordRuntimeSignal {
    when: RuntimeSignalCaptured(orc, signal)
    requires: signal.identity != ""
    requires: signal.cycle_identity != ""
    requires: signal.producer != ""
    requires: signal.dropped_count >= 0
    ensures: RuntimeSignal.created(
        identity: signal.identity,
        cycle_identity: signal.cycle_identity,
        item_identity: signal.item_identity,
        operation_identity: signal.operation_identity,
        trace_identity: signal.trace_identity,
        event_identity: signal.event_identity,
        kind: signal.kind,
        producer: signal.producer,
        authority: signal.authority,
        purpose: signal.purpose,
        subject_digest: signal.subject_digest,
        content_digest: signal.content_digest,
        complete: signal.complete,
        sampled: signal.sampled,
        dropped_count: signal.dropped_count,
        collection_reason: signal.collection_reason
    )
}

Given an accepted domain event and every required projection snapshot

rule EvaluateCompleteInvariant {
    when: IndependentInvariantChecked(orc, cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity,
                                      producer, subject_digest, signals, verdict, evidence_digest)
    requires: signals.count > 0
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.cycle_identity = cycle_identity)
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.subject_digest = subject_digest)
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.complete)
    requires: signals.all(signal => not signal.sampled)
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.dropped_count = 0)
    requires: verdict = pass or verdict = fail
    ensures: IndependentInvariantEvaluation.created(
        identity: invariant_evaluation_identity(cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity),
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        item_identity: item_identity,
        invariant_identity: invariant_identity,
        producer: producer,
        authority: independent_validator,
        input_signals: signals,
        subject_digest: subject_digest,
        verdict: verdict,
        evidence_digest: evidence_digest
    )
}

rule MarkIncompleteInvariantInconclusive {
    when: IndependentInvariantInputsIncomplete(orc, cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity,
                                               producer, subject_digest, signals, evidence_digest)
    requires: signals.count = 0 or
        exists signals where not complete or sampled or dropped_count > 0
    requires: incomplete_collection_reason(signals) != ""
    ensures: IndependentInvariantEvaluation.created(
        identity: invariant_evaluation_identity(cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity),
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        item_identity: item_identity,
        invariant_identity: invariant_identity,
        producer: producer,
        authority: independent_validator,

        verdict: inconclusive,
        evidence_digest: evidence_digest
    )
}

rule PrepareCutTask {
    when: SubmitCutPreparationTask(operator_session, request_identity, request_digest, source_commit, backend)
    requires: full_source_commit(source_commit)
    requires: supported_backend(backend)
    requires: not exists WorkflowTask{request_identity: request_identity, kind: cut_preparation}
    ensures: WorkflowTask.created(
        identity: next_task_identity(),
        kind: cut_preparation,
        request_identity: request_identity,
        request_digest: request_digest,
        status: submitted,
        trace_identity: null,
        outcome: null,
        preparation_identity: null,
        parent_cycle_identity: null
    )
}

@item-04-013 · The control plane does not depend on one interactive session implementation deferred
@item-04-013@deferred@allium-rule-success.SubmitCycle@allium-guarantee.SessionAgnosticControl@allium-guarantee.FixedContractOwnershipdeferred
Scenario: The control plane does not depend on one interactive session implementation
Given a Codex, Pi, or other authorized operator session
When it supplies an immutable approved fixed execution contract through the public control plane
Then ORC starts the same regeneration cycle contract
And ORC owns its bounded prompt, tool surface, retries, termination, and result
And disconnecting that session does not stop the internal ORC cycle
.pi/model/plan/04-operator-control-plane/spec.feature:110 · Rule: Any operator session can drive the outer lifecycle
Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule SubmitCycle {
    when: SubmitRegenerationCycle(operator, request_identity, request_digest, preparation, parent_cycle_identity, backend)
    requires: preparation.status = approved
    requires: fixed_bounded_execution_contract(preparation)
    requires: preparation.selection.items.count > 0
    requires: not exists RegenerationCycle{identity: request_identity}
    requires: preparation.execution_profile = automatic or
              (preparation.execution_profile = host_development and backend = host) or
              (preparation.execution_profile = gondolin_isolated and backend = gondolin)
    ensures: RegenerationCycle.created(
        identity: request_identity,
        request_digest: request_digest,
        preparation: preparation,
        parent_cycle_identity: parent_cycle_identity,
        status: submitted,
        stage: fence,
        candidate_digest: null,
        failure_stage: null,
        failure_kind: null,
        failure_reason: null
    )
}

Scenario: Submitting the whole plan approves its fixed preparation and submits one cycle
Given the Pi harness was started on a pinned cut whose plan has stamped items

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule ApproveWholePlanBySubmission {
    when: SubmitWholePlanRegeneration(operator, request_identity, request_digest)
    let plan = whole_plan_preparation(pinned_cut())
    requires: plan.selection.items.count > 0
    requires: not exists RegenerationCycle{identity: request_identity}
    ensures:
        let preparation = CyclePreparation.created(
            identity: whole_plan_preparation_identity(pinned_cut()),
            digest: plan.digest,
            status: approved,
            selection: plan.selection,
            scope: plan.scope,
            target_stack: plan.target_stack,
            execution_profile: plan.execution_profile,
            cut_digest: plan.cut_digest,
            grader_digest: plan.grader_digest,
            diagram_digest: plan.diagram_digest,
            max_outer_cycles: 1
        )
        RegenerationCycle.created(
            identity: request_identity,
            preparation: preparation,
            request_digest: request_digest,
            parent_cycle_identity: null,
            status: submitted,
            stage: fence,
            candidate_digest: null,
            failure_stage: null,
            failure_kind: null,
            failure_reason: null
        )
}
