rule BindSuccessfulBaselineTrace {
    when: BaselineGradeCompleted(orc, cycle_identity, evaluation, trace)
    requires: evaluation.verdict = pass
    requires: trace.cycle_identity = cycle_identity
    requires: trace.path = config.baseline_trace_path
    requires: trace.complete
    requires: trace.authority = independent_validator
    ensures: BaselineTraceBinding.created(
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        evidence_digest: evaluation.evidence_digest,
        trace: trace
    )
}

    Scenario: A system view that does not decompose into the same slice mappings is refused
    Given a prepared cut whose slice mappings reduce to its system view
    But decomposing that system view gives slice mappings other than the ones it was reduced from

    And no system composition is recorded for the cut

Scenario: Slice mappings reconstruct the complete cut-bound system view
Given a prepared cut contains Gherkin behavior items grouped into slices, components, and containers
When the harness maps each item and reduces those mappings into a system view
Then every behavior item appears exactly once in the reconstructed hierarchy
And decomposing that hierarchy reproduces the same slice mappings
And any missing, duplicate, or conflicting mapping makes the composition invalid
.pi/model/plan/01-regeneration-cycle/spec.feature:37 · Rule: The neutral source cut is pinned and physically fenced
Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule ComposeCutSystemView {
    when: ComposeSystemView(operator, cut)
    requires: cut.fenced
    let slice_mappings = map_items_to_slices(cut)
    requires: every_item_mapped_exactly_once(cut, slice_mappings)
    requires: reduce_to_system_view(slice_mappings) = complete_system_view(cut)
    requires: decompose_system_view(complete_system_view(cut)) = slice_mappings
    ensures: SystemComposition.created(
        cut: cut,
        digest: composition_digest(cut, slice_mappings),
        slice_mappings: slice_mappings
    )
}

Examples
@item-03-002 · A grader is written once from the spec and calibrated before it is sealed balance
@item-03-002@balance@allium-invariant.GraderAuthorRoomHoldsOnlySpecAndProtocol@allium-rule-success.RequestGraderAuthoring@allium-rule-success.AuthorGrader@allium-rule-success.SealCalibratedGrader@allium-rule-failure.SealCalibratedGrader.3@allium-rule-failure.SealCalibratedGrader.4@allium-rule-success.ReauthorUncalibratedGrader@allium-rule-failure.ReauthorUncalibratedGrader.2@allium-boundary.CandidateBlindAuthorbalance
Scenario: A grader is written once from the spec and calibrated before it is sealed
Given no sealed grader covers a checklist item's scenario digest
When an independent grader author derives a grader from only the selected Gherkin and the public calibration protocol
Then the author cannot read any candidate, builder or gate transcript, prior verdict, or host credential
And ORC calibrates the grader so carried behavior passes and uncarried behavior fails for every item
And an uncalibrated grader is discarded and re-authored from the failing calibration cases, at most three attempts
And only a calibrated grader is sealed under its scenario digests and offered for approval
.pi/model/plan/03-instrument/spec.feature:22 · Rule: The grader is a sealed, calibrated instrument, not a per-cycle guess
Source: .pi/model/instrument.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule RequestGraderAuthoring {
    when: RequestGrader(operator, checklist)
    requires: not exists approved_grader_covering(checklist)
    ensures: GraderAuthoringRequested(
        scenario_digests: checklist_scenario_digests(checklist),
        attempt: 1,
        failed_cases: []
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/instrument.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule FileScore {
    when: ScoreReturned(orc, cycle, grader, checklist, verdicts)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = score
    requires: grader.status = approved
    requires: grader.digest = cycle.preparation.grader_digest
    requires: verdicts.count > 0
    requires: every_verdict_names_a_checklist_item(verdicts, checklist)
    requires: every_verdict_is_pass_or_fail(verdicts)
    let items = one_score_per_checklist_item(checklist, verdicts)
    ensures: CycleMeasurement.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        grader_digest: grader.digest,
        total: checklist.items.count,
        passed: items.count(item => item.verdict = pass),
        failed: items.count(item => item.verdict = fail),
        complete: items.all(item => item.reached),
        items: items
    )
}

rule StartPromptOptimization {
    when: OptimizeBuilderInstruction(
        operator,
        optimization_identity,
        purpose,
        reflection_provider,
        reflection_model,
        training_examples,
        validation_examples
    )
    requires: reflection_provider = config.reflection_provider
    requires: reflection_model != ""
    requires: training_examples.count > 0
    requires: validation_examples.count > 0
    ensures: PromptOptimization.created(
        identity: optimization_identity,
        purpose: purpose,
        status: evaluating,
        reflection: ReflectionModelBinding{
            provider: reflection_provider,
            model: reflection_model
        },
        training_examples: training_examples,
        validation_examples: validation_examples,
        winning_instruction: null
    )
}

rule ReauthorUncalibratedGrader {
    when: GraderCalibrationFailed(orc, grader, failed_cases)
    requires: grader.status = calibrating
    requires: grader.attempt < 3
    requires: failed_cases_come_only_from_public_protocol(failed_cases)
    ensures: grader.status = discarded
    ensures: GraderAuthoringRequested(
        scenario_digests: grader.scenario_digests,
        attempt: grader.attempt + 1,
        failed_cases: failed_cases
    )
}

Examples
@item-02-018 · A builder session is keyed by its ORC tick and resumes rather than restarts balance
@item-02-018@balance@allium-rule-success.LaunchDurableBuilderSession@allium-rule-success.ResumeDurableBuilderSession@allium-invariant.DurableSessionIsKeyedByTickbalance
Scenario: A builder session is keyed by its ORC tick and resumes rather than restarts
Given ORC starts a tick for a slice builder, a repair builder, or a grader author
When ORC launches that tick's builder session
Then the session is a durable Pi session identified by the tick
And a relaunch of the same tick after a crash resumes that session from its committed turns
And a relaunch never starts a second session for the same tick
And the model credentials stay on the host and never enter the room
.pi/model/plan/02-execution-pipeline/spec.feature:164 · Rule: ORC launches every builder as a durable Pi session in a room ORC chooses
Source: .pi/model/execution-pipeline.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule LaunchDurableBuilderSession {
    when: BuilderTickStarted(orc, tick_identity, cycle, attempt, role, room, production_prompt_digest)
    requires: not exists BuilderSession{tick_identity: tick_identity}
    requires: room.cut_read_only
    requires: not room.egress_allowed
    requires: not room.inherits_host_environment
    requires: room.writable_scope.count > 0 or role = grader_author
    requires: role = repair_builder implies room.evidence_root != null
    requires: role != repair_builder implies room.evidence_root = null
    requires: role = grader_author implies cycle = null
    requires: role != grader_author implies cycle != null and attempt != null
    ensures: BuilderSession.created(
        tick_identity: tick_identity,
        role: role,
        session_identity: durable_session_for(tick_identity),
        cycle: cycle,
        attempt: attempt,
        room: room,
        production_prompt_digest: production_prompt_digest,
        status: running,
        launches: 1,
        assisted: false,
        last_intervention: null
    )
}

rule ResumeDurableBuilderSession {
    when: BuilderTickRelaunched(orc, builder_session, room, production_prompt_digest)
    requires: room = builder_session.room
    requires: production_prompt_digest = builder_session.production_prompt_digest
    requires: builder_session.status = running
    ensures: builder_session.launches = builder_session.launches + 1
}

Source: .pi/model/execution-pipeline.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule RegenerateCandidate {
    when: BuilderCompleted(orc, cycle, attempt, builder_session, subject_digest,
                           generated_paths, tool_calls)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = regenerate
    requires: attempt >= 1
    requires: attempt <= 3
    requires: builder_session.cycle = cycle
    requires: builder_session.attempt = attempt
    requires: builder_session.role != grader_author
    requires: generated_paths.count > 0
    requires: tool_calls > 0
    requires: attempt > 1 implies builder_inputs_are_previous_candidate_and_gate_evidence(cycle, attempt)
    requires: attempt = 1 implies completed_slice_builds(cycle) = selected_slice_count(cycle)
    ensures: CandidateSubject.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        attempt: attempt,
        digest: subject_digest,
        generated_paths: generated_paths,
        tool_calls: tool_calls
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = gate
}

    1 scenario@allium-rule-failure.ReauthorUncalibratedGrader.2
    @item-03-002 · A grader is written once from the spec and calibrated before it is sealed balance
    @item-03-002@balance@allium-invariant.GraderAuthorRoomHoldsOnlySpecAndProtocol@allium-rule-success.RequestGraderAuthoring@allium-rule-success.AuthorGrader@allium-rule-success.SealCalibratedGrader@allium-rule-failure.SealCalibratedGrader.3@allium-rule-failure.SealCalibratedGrader.4@allium-rule-success.ReauthorUncalibratedGrader@allium-rule-failure.ReauthorUncalibratedGrader.2@allium-boundary.CandidateBlindAuthorbalance
    Scenario: A grader is written once from the spec and calibrated before it is sealed
    Given no sealed grader covers a checklist item's scenario digest
    When an independent grader author derives a grader from only the selected Gherkin and the public calibration protocol
    Then the author cannot read any candidate, builder or gate transcript, prior verdict, or host credential

rule ReauthorUncalibratedGrader {
    when: GraderCalibrationFailed(orc, grader, failed_cases)
    requires: grader.status = calibrating
    requires: grader.attempt < 3
    requires: failed_cases_come_only_from_public_protocol(failed_cases)
    ensures: grader.status = discarded
    ensures: GraderAuthoringRequested(
        scenario_digests: grader.scenario_digests,
        attempt: grader.attempt + 1,
        failed_cases: failed_cases
    )
}

rule BindSuccessfulBaselineTrace {
    when: BaselineGradeCompleted(orc, cycle_identity, evaluation, trace)
    requires: evaluation.verdict = pass
    requires: trace.cycle_identity = cycle_identity
    requires: trace.path = config.baseline_trace_path
    requires: trace.complete
    requires: trace.authority = independent_validator
    ensures: BaselineTraceBinding.created(
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        evidence_digest: evaluation.evidence_digest,
        trace: trace
    )
}

        builder_session_identity: builder_session_identity,
        durable_cursor: durable_cursor
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule PreviewSelection {
    when: PreviewSliceSelection(operator, cut, project_identity, slice_identity, requested_items)
    requires: cut.fenced
    requires: slice_identity in composed_slice_identities(cut)
    let resolved_items = resolve_items(cut, project_identity, slice_identity, requested_items)
    requires: resolved_items.count > 0
    ensures: SliceSelection.created(
        identity: selection_identity(cut, project_identity, slice_identity, resolved_items),
        digest: selection_digest(cut, project_identity, slice_identity, resolved_items),
        status: awaiting_approval,
        cut: cut,
        project_identity: project_identity,
        container_identity: container_for(cut, slice_identity),
        component_identity: component_for(cut, slice_identity),
        slice_identity: slice_identity,
        items: resolved_items
    )
}

rule ProposeSelectionFromIntent {
    when: ProposeSliceSelection(operator, cut, project_identity, operator_intent)
    requires: cut.fenced
    let proposed_slice_identity = proposed_slice(cut, project_identity, operator_intent)
    requires: proposed_slice_identity in composed_slice_identities(cut)
    let resolved_items = resolve_items(
        cut, project_identity, proposed_slice_identity,
        proposed_items(cut, project_identity, operator_intent))
    requires: resolved_items.count > 0
    ensures: SliceSelection.created(
        identity: selection_identity(cut, project_identity, proposed_slice_identity, resolved_items),
        digest: selection_digest(cut, project_identity, proposed_slice_identity, resolved_items),
        status: awaiting_approval,
        cut: cut,
        project_identity: project_identity,
        container_identity: container_for(cut, proposed_slice_identity),
        component_identity: component_for(cut, proposed_slice_identity),
        slice_identity: proposed_slice_identity,
        items: resolved_items
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/instrument.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule FileScore {
    when: ScoreReturned(orc, cycle, grader, checklist, verdicts)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = score
    requires: grader.status = approved
    requires: grader.digest = cycle.preparation.grader_digest
    requires: verdicts.count > 0
    requires: every_verdict_names_a_checklist_item(verdicts, checklist)
    requires: every_verdict_is_pass_or_fail(verdicts)
    let items = one_score_per_checklist_item(checklist, verdicts)
    ensures: CycleMeasurement.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        grader_digest: grader.digest,
        total: checklist.items.count,
        passed: items.count(item => item.verdict = pass),
        failed: items.count(item => item.verdict = fail),
        complete: items.all(item => item.reached),
        items: items
    )
}

rule SealCalibratedGrader {
    when: GraderCalibrated(orc, grader, carried_passed, uncarried_failed)
    requires: grader.status = calibrating
    requires: grader_author_read_only_spec_and_protocol(grader.author_session_identity)
    requires: carried_passed
    requires: uncarried_failed
    ensures: grader.status = sealed
}

Source: .pi/model/runtime-evidence.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule RecordRuntimeSignal {
    when: RuntimeSignalCaptured(orc, signal)
    requires: signal.identity != ""
    requires: signal.cycle_identity != ""
    requires: signal.producer != ""
    requires: signal.dropped_count >= 0
    ensures: RuntimeSignal.created(
        identity: signal.identity,
        cycle_identity: signal.cycle_identity,
        item_identity: signal.item_identity,
        operation_identity: signal.operation_identity,
        trace_identity: signal.trace_identity,
        event_identity: signal.event_identity,
        kind: signal.kind,
        producer: signal.producer,
        authority: signal.authority,
        purpose: signal.purpose,
        subject_digest: signal.subject_digest,
        content_digest: signal.content_digest,
        complete: signal.complete,
        sampled: signal.sampled,
        dropped_count: signal.dropped_count,
        collection_reason: signal.collection_reason
    )
}

Scenario: A passing invariant uses one correlated candidate subject
Given an accepted domain event and every required projection snapshot
And every signal names the same cycle, operation, event, aggregate, and subject digest
When the independent validator evaluates the named product invariant
Then it may record an evidence-backed passing observation
And the observation identifies every input artifact digest
.pi/model/plan/05-runtime-evidence/spec.feature:35 · Rule: Runtime evidence preserves authority and collection quality
Source: .pi/model/runtime-evidence.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule EvaluateCompleteInvariant {
    when: IndependentInvariantChecked(orc, cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity,
                                      producer, subject_digest, signals, verdict, evidence_digest)
    requires: signals.count > 0
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.cycle_identity = cycle_identity)
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.subject_digest = subject_digest)
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.complete)
    requires: signals.all(signal => not signal.sampled)
    requires: signals.all(signal => signal.dropped_count = 0)
    requires: verdict = pass or verdict = fail
    ensures: IndependentInvariantEvaluation.created(
        identity: invariant_evaluation_identity(cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity),
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        item_identity: item_identity,
        invariant_identity: invariant_identity,
        producer: producer,
        authority: independent_validator,
        input_signals: signals,
        subject_digest: subject_digest,
        verdict: verdict,
        evidence_digest: evidence_digest
    )
}

@item-05-003@deferred@allium-rule-success.MarkIncompleteInvariantInconclusive@allium-invariant.PassingEvaluationRequiresCompleteCollection@allium-invariant.DiagnosticSignalCannotDetermineVerdict@allium-guarantee.IncompleteMeansInconclusivedeferred
Scenario: Missing or dropped required signals are inconclusive
Given the sealed grader carries the generic evaluator for the runtime signals declared by the approved project model
And one required signal is missing, incomplete, sampled, or reported as dropped
When the score stage evaluates the captured evidence for an item
Then it persists an inconclusive invariant evaluation
And the approved item cannot pass the score
And collection status identifies the affected signal kind and reason
And diagnostic profiles remain available but cannot author a verdict

Source: .pi/model/runtime-evidence.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule MarkIncompleteInvariantInconclusive {
    when: IndependentInvariantInputsIncomplete(orc, cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity,
                                               producer, subject_digest, signals, evidence_digest)
    requires: signals.count = 0 or
        exists signals where not complete or sampled or dropped_count > 0
    requires: incomplete_collection_reason(signals) != ""
    ensures: IndependentInvariantEvaluation.created(
        identity: invariant_evaluation_identity(cycle_identity, item_identity, invariant_identity),
        cycle_identity: cycle_identity,
        item_identity: item_identity,
        invariant_identity: invariant_identity,
        producer: producer,
        authority: independent_validator,
        input_signals: signals,
        subject_digest: subject_digest,
        verdict: inconclusive,
        evidence_digest: evidence_digest
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/instrument.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule ApproveExactGrader {
    when: ApproveGrader(operator, grader, supplied_digest)
    requires: grader.status = sealed
    requires: supplied_digest = grader.digest
    requires: grader.replaces = null or grader.replacement_reason != null
    requires: grader.replacement_reason = spec_grew implies
              only_adds_items(grader.replaces, grader)
    ensures: grader.status = approved
}

rule ReauthorUncalibratedGrader {
    when: GraderCalibrationFailed(orc, grader, failed_cases)
    requires: grader.status = calibrating
    requires: grader.attempt < 3
    requires: failed_cases_come_only_from_public_protocol(failed_cases)
    ensures: grader.status = discarded
    ensures: GraderAuthoringRequested(
        scenario_digests: grader.scenario_digests,
        attempt: grader.attempt + 1,
        failed_cases: failed_cases
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule ApproveWholePlanBySubmission {
    when: SubmitWholePlanRegeneration(operator, request_identity, request_digest)
    let plan = whole_plan_preparation(pinned_cut())
    requires: plan.selection.items.count > 0
    requires: not exists RegenerationCycle{identity: request_identity}
    ensures:
        let preparation = CyclePreparation.created(
            identity: whole_plan_preparation_identity(pinned_cut()),
            digest: plan.digest,
            status: approved,
            selection: plan.selection,
            scope: plan.scope,
            target_stack: plan.target_stack,
            execution_profile: plan.execution_profile,
            cut_digest: plan.cut_digest,
            grader_digest: plan.grader_digest,
            diagram_digest: plan.diagram_digest,
            max_outer_cycles: 1
        )
        RegenerationCycle.created(
            identity: request_identity,
            preparation: preparation,
            request_digest: request_digest,
            parent_cycle_identity: null,
            status: submitted,
            stage: fence,
            candidate_digest: null,
            failure_stage: null,
            failure_kind: null,
            failure_reason: null
        )
}

Given an approved selection of several plan slices
When the regenerate stage runs its first attempt

Source: .pi/model/execution-pipeline.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule BuildSlice {
    when: SliceBuilderCompleted(orc, cycle, slice, position, builder_session, generated_paths)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = regenerate
    requires: builder_session.cycle = cycle
    requires: builder_session.role = slice_builder
    requires: position = selected_slice_position(cycle, slice)
    requires: completed_slice_builds(cycle) = position - 1
    requires: slice_builder_inputs_are_clean_room_and_cycle_candidate(cycle, slice)
    requires: generated_paths.count > 0
    ensures: SliceBuild.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        slice: slice,
        position: position,
        builder_session: builder_session,
        generated_paths: generated_paths
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/prompt-optimization.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule SelectWinningInstruction {
    when: InstructionWinnerSelected(orc, optimization, winner)
    requires: optimization.status = evaluating
    requires: winner.optimization = optimization
    requires: winner.status = measured
    requires: winner.instruction.purpose = optimization.purpose
    requires: winner.independent_score = highest_measured_score(optimization)
    let prior = selected_candidate_for(optimization.purpose)
    ensures:
        winner.status = selected
        if prior != null:
            prior.status = superseded
    ensures: optimization.winning_instruction = winner.instruction
    ensures: optimization.status = optimized
    ensures: InstructionActivated(
        purpose: optimization.purpose,
        instruction_identity: winner.instruction.identity,
        text_digest: winner.instruction.text_digest
    )
}

rule FenceCleanRoom {
    when: CleanRoomProved(orc, cycle, cut_digest, fenced_paths, harness_digest)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = fence
    requires: exists HarnessSelfCheck{harness_digest: harness_digest, passed: true}
    requires: approved_grader_covers(cycle.preparation.grader_digest, cycle.preparation.selection.items)
    requires: fenced_paths.count > 0
    requires: every_fenced_path_matches(cut_digest, fenced_paths)
    ensures: CleanRoom.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        cut_digest: cut_digest,
        fenced_paths: fenced_paths,
        single_root_commit: true,
        fenced_paths_unreachable: true
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = regenerate
}

    when: DeriveSelectionChecklist(operator, selection, scenarios)
    requires: scenarios.count > 0
    requires: every_scenario_has_stamped_identity(scenarios)
    requires: selection.status = approved
    ensures: Checklist.created(

        items: ordered_by_file_then_position(one_item_per_titled_scenario(scenarios))
    )
}

Examples
@item-02-018 · A builder session is keyed by its ORC tick and resumes rather than restarts balance
@item-02-018@balance@allium-rule-success.LaunchDurableBuilderSession@allium-rule-success.ResumeDurableBuilderSession@allium-invariant.DurableSessionIsKeyedByTickbalance
Scenario: A builder session is keyed by its ORC tick and resumes rather than restarts
Given ORC starts a tick for a slice builder, a repair builder, or a grader author
When ORC launches that tick's builder session
Then the session is a durable Pi session identified by the tick
And a relaunch of the same tick after a crash resumes that session from its committed turns
And a relaunch never starts a second session for the same tick
And the model credentials stay on the host and never enter the room
.pi/model/plan/02-execution-pipeline/spec.feature:164 · Rule: ORC launches every builder as a durable Pi session in a room ORC chooses
Source: .pi/model/execution-pipeline.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule LaunchDurableBuilderSession {
    when: BuilderTickStarted(orc, tick_identity, cycle, attempt, role, room, production_prompt_digest)
    requires: not exists BuilderSession{tick_identity: tick_identity}
    requires: room.cut_read_only
    requires: not room.egress_allowed
    requires: not room.inherits_host_environment
    requires: room.writable_scope.count > 0 or role = grader_author
    requires: role = repair_builder implies room.evidence_root != null
    requires: role != repair_builder implies room.evidence_root = null
    requires: role = grader_author implies cycle = null
    requires: role != grader_author implies cycle != null and attempt != null
    ensures: BuilderSession.created(
        tick_identity: tick_identity,
        role: role,
        session_identity: durable_session_for(tick_identity),
        cycle: cycle,
        attempt: attempt,
        room: room,
        production_prompt_digest: production_prompt_digest,
        status: running,
        launches: 1,
        assisted: false,
        last_intervention: null
    )
}

rule ResumeDurableBuilderSession {
    when: BuilderTickRelaunched(orc, builder_session, room, production_prompt_digest)
    requires: room = builder_session.room
    requires: production_prompt_digest = builder_session.production_prompt_digest
    requires: builder_session.status = running
    ensures: builder_session.launches = builder_session.launches + 1
}

        committed_result: committed_result,
        generation: generation

rule ApproveWholePlanBySubmission {
    when: SubmitWholePlanRegeneration(operator, request_identity, request_digest)
    let plan = whole_plan_preparation(pinned_cut())
    requires: plan.selection.items.count > 0
    requires: not exists RegenerationCycle{identity: request_identity}
    ensures:
        let preparation = CyclePreparation.created(
            identity: whole_plan_preparation_identity(pinned_cut()),
            digest: plan.digest,
            status: approved,
            selection: plan.selection,
            scope: plan.scope,
            target_stack: plan.target_stack,
            execution_profile: plan.execution_profile,
            cut_digest: plan.cut_digest,
            grader_digest: plan.grader_digest,
            diagram_digest: plan.diagram_digest,
            max_outer_cycles: 1
        )
        RegenerationCycle.created(
            identity: request_identity,
            preparation: preparation,
            request_digest: request_digest,
            parent_cycle_identity: null,
            status: submitted,
            stage: fence,
            candidate_digest: null,
            failure_stage: null,
            failure_kind: null,
            failure_reason: null
        )
}

rule RecordRuntimeSignal {
    when: RuntimeSignalCaptured(orc, signal)
    requires: signal.identity != ""
    requires: signal.cycle_identity != ""
    requires: signal.producer != ""
    requires: signal.dropped_count >= 0
    ensures: RuntimeSignal.created(
        identity: signal.identity,
        cycle_identity: signal.cycle_identity,
        item_identity: signal.item_identity,
        operation_identity: signal.operation_identity,
        trace_identity: signal.trace_identity,
        event_identity: signal.event_identity,
        kind: signal.kind,
        producer: signal.producer,
        authority: signal.authority,
        purpose: signal.purpose,
        subject_digest: signal.subject_digest,
        content_digest: signal.content_digest,
        complete: signal.complete,
        sampled: signal.sampled,
        dropped_count: signal.dropped_count,
        collection_reason: signal.collection_reason
    )
}

Given prompt optimization evaluated one or more instruction candidates for one purpose
When optimization completes

Source: .pi/model/prompt-optimization.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule SelectWinningInstruction {
    when: InstructionWinnerSelected(orc, optimization, winner)
    requires: optimization.status = evaluating
    requires: winner.optimization = optimization
    requires: winner.status = measured
    requires: winner.instruction.purpose = optimization.purpose
    requires: winner.independent_score = highest_measured_score(optimization)
    let prior = selected_candidate_for(optimization.purpose)
    ensures:
        winner.status = selected
        if prior != null:
            prior.status = superseded
    ensures: optimization.winning_instruction = winner.instruction
    ensures: optimization.status = optimized
    ensures: InstructionActivated(
        purpose: optimization.purpose,
        instruction_identity: winner.instruction.identity,
        text_digest: winner.instruction.text_digest
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule ComposeCutSystemView {
    when: ComposeSystemView(operator, cut)
    requires: cut.fenced
    let slice_mappings = map_items_to_slices(cut)
    requires: every_item_mapped_exactly_once(cut, slice_mappings)
    requires: reduce_to_system_view(slice_mappings) = complete_system_view(cut)
    requires: decompose_system_view(complete_system_view(cut)) = slice_mappings
    ensures: SystemComposition.created(
        cut: cut,
        digest: composition_digest(cut, slice_mappings),
        slice_mappings: slice_mappings
    )
}

    when: RequestGrader(operator, checklist)
    requires: not exists approved_grader_covering(checklist)
    ensures: GraderAuthoringRequested(
        scenario_digests: checklist_scenario_digests(checklist),
        attempt: 1,
        failed_cases: []
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/instrument.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule ApproveExactGrader {
    when: ApproveGrader(operator, grader, supplied_digest)
    requires: grader.status = sealed
    requires: supplied_digest = grader.digest
    requires: grader.replaces = null or grader.replacement_reason != null
    requires: grader.replacement_reason = spec_grew implies
              only_adds_items(grader.replaces, grader)
    ensures: grader.status = approved
}

Source: .pi/model/regeneration-cycle.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule SubmitCycle {
    when: SubmitRegenerationCycle(operator, request_identity, request_digest, preparation, parent_cycle_identity, backend)
    requires: preparation.status = approved
    requires: fixed_bounded_execution_contract(preparation)
    requires: preparation.selection.items.count > 0
    requires: not exists RegenerationCycle{identity: request_identity}
    requires: preparation.execution_profile = automatic or
              (preparation.execution_profile = host_development and backend = host) or
              (preparation.execution_profile = gondolin_isolated and backend = gondolin)
    ensures: RegenerationCycle.created(
        identity: request_identity,
        request_digest: request_digest,
        preparation: preparation,
        parent_cycle_identity: parent_cycle_identity,
        status: submitted,
        stage: fence,
        candidate_digest: null,
        failure_stage: null,
        failure_kind: null,
        failure_reason: null
    )
}

rule ApproveWholePlanBySubmission {
    when: SubmitWholePlanRegeneration(operator, request_identity, request_digest)
    let plan = whole_plan_preparation(pinned_cut())
    requires: plan.selection.items.count > 0
    requires: not exists RegenerationCycle{identity: request_identity}
    ensures:
        let preparation = CyclePreparation.created(
            identity: whole_plan_preparation_identity(pinned_cut()),
            digest: plan.digest,
            status: approved,
            selection: plan.selection,
            scope: plan.scope,
            target_stack: plan.target_stack,
            execution_profile: plan.execution_profile,
            cut_digest: plan.cut_digest,
            grader_digest: plan.grader_digest,
            diagram_digest: plan.diagram_digest,
            max_outer_cycles: 1
        )
        RegenerationCycle.created(
            identity: request_identity,
            preparation: preparation,
            request_digest: request_digest,
            parent_cycle_identity: null,
            status: submitted,
            stage: fence,
            candidate_digest: null,
            failure_stage: null,
            failure_kind: null,
            failure_reason: null
        )
}

PassGate

on eventissued byadvance-cycle-stageEvent Modeldraft
Given
  • eventBuilder completed (RegenerationCycle.stage = gate)
When
gate_attempt: GateAttempt.created
Only if
  1. 1
    gate_attempt.cycle.stage = gate
    draft@allium-rule-failure.PassGate.1
    draft · A gate attempt recorded for a cycle no longer at the gate moves nothing draft
    @draft@allium-rule-failure.PassGate.1@allium-rule-failure.RepairAfterFailedGate.1@allium-rule-failure.FailAfterThreeGateAttempts.1draft
    Scenario: A gate attempt recorded for a cycle no longer at the gate moves nothing
    Given a regeneration cycle that has left the gate
    When a gate attempt for that cycle is recorded
    Then the cycle does not move to the score or the regenerate stage
    And the cycle's stage and status are unchanged
    .pi/model/plan/02-execution-pipeline/drafts.feature:271
  2. 2
    gate_attempt.passed
    draft@allium-rule-failure.PassGate.2
    draft · A passing gate attempt moves the cycle to the score and only a passing one does draft
    @draft@allium-rule-success.PassGate@allium-rule-failure.PassGate.2@allium-rule-failure.RepairAfterFailedGate.2@allium-rule-failure.FailAfterThreeGateAttempts.2draft
    Scenario: A passing gate attempt moves the cycle to the score and only a passing one does
    Given a running regeneration cycle at the gate with the candidate subject of attempt 3
    When ORC reports the gate passed for attempt 3
    Then the cycle moves to the score
    And no repair builder session starts and the cycle does not fail at the gate
    But a gate that did not pass never moves a cycle to the score
    .pi/model/plan/02-execution-pipeline/drafts.feature:236
Then
  • setsstage = score

Examples
@item-02-004 · The gate ratifies done; the builder cannot minimum
@item-02-004@minimum@allium-guarantee.IndependentMeasurement@allium-invariant.GatePassRequiresObservedRun@allium-rule-success.RepairAfterFailedGate@allium-rule-success.FailAfterThreeGateAttemptsminimum
Scenario: The gate ratifies done; the builder cannot
Given the builder reports that the candidate is complete
When the gate stage runs in an independent room
Then the candidate is done only if the gate boots it fresh and proves its suite green
And the gate records the subject digest without changing the candidate
And a failed gate starts a fresh builder session with only the preceding candidate and the gate's evidence
And the cycle fails at the gate after three regenerate attempts
.pi/model/plan/02-execution-pipeline/spec.feature:39 · Rule: The fence and the gate feed the build loop; the score never does

Scenario: A failed second gate attempt returns the cycle to the regenerate stage
Given a running regeneration cycle at the gate with the candidate subject of attempt 2
When ORC reports the gate failed for attempt 2 with its reason
Then the cycle returns to the regenerate stage for a repair builder
And the cycle does not fail at the gate
.pi/model/plan/02-execution-pipeline/drafts.feature:248

}

rule RunHarnessSelfCheck {
    when: HarnessSelfCheckRan(orc, harness_digest, golden_digests, failing_checks)
    requires: golden_digests.count > 0
    ensures: HarnessSelfCheck.created(
        harness_digest: harness_digest,
        golden_digests: golden_digests,
        passed: failing_checks.count = 0,
        failing_checks: failing_checks
    )
}

rule RenderProductionPrompt {
    when: ProductionPromptRendered(
        orc,
        role,
        system_instruction_digest,
        task_instruction_digest,
        runtime_task_context_digest
    )
    requires: system_instruction_digest != ""
    requires: task_instruction_digest != ""
    requires: runtime_task_context_digest != ""
    ensures: ProductionPrompt.created(
        identity: production_prompt_identity(
            role,
            system_instruction_digest,
            task_instruction_digest,
            runtime_task_context_digest
        ),
        role: role,
        system_instruction_digest: system_instruction_digest,
        task_instruction_digest: task_instruction_digest,
        runtime_task_context_digest: runtime_task_context_digest,
        digest: production_prompt_digest_of(
            system_instruction_digest,
            task_instruction_digest,
            runtime_task_context_digest
        )
    )
}

rule ReauthorUncalibratedGrader {
    when: GraderCalibrationFailed(orc, grader, failed_cases)
    requires: grader.status = calibrating
    requires: grader.attempt < 3
    requires: failed_cases_come_only_from_public_protocol(failed_cases)
    ensures: grader.status = discarded
    ensures: GraderAuthoringRequested(
        scenario_digests: grader.scenario_digests,
        attempt: grader.attempt + 1,
        failed_cases: failed_cases
    )
}

Source: .pi/model/execution-pipeline.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule RegenerateCandidate {
    when: BuilderCompleted(orc, cycle, attempt, builder_session, subject_digest,
                           generated_paths, tool_calls)
    requires: cycle.status = running
    requires: cycle.stage = regenerate
    requires: attempt >= 1
    requires: attempt <= 3
    requires: builder_session.cycle = cycle
    requires: builder_session.attempt = attempt
    requires: builder_session.role != grader_author
    requires: generated_paths.count > 0
    requires: tool_calls > 0
    requires: attempt > 1 implies builder_inputs_are_previous_candidate_and_gate_evidence(cycle, attempt)
    requires: attempt = 1 implies completed_slice_builds(cycle) = selected_slice_count(cycle)
    ensures: CandidateSubject.created(
        cycle: cycle,
        attempt: attempt,
        digest: subject_digest,
        generated_paths: generated_paths,
        tool_calls: tool_calls
    )
    ensures: cycle.stage = gate
}

Scenario: An instruction candidate is measured under the exact production prompt it ran with
Given ORC proposed an instruction candidate for fresh generation
And ORC rendered a slice builder's production prompt whose task instruction is that candidate's builder instruction
And the builder host transported that production prompt unchanged
When ORC returns an independent metric from a fresh approved cut, with the fresh builder's gate result and a complete black-box grade
Then the instruction candidate is measured
And it records that production prompt's digest, the independent score, and the metric evidence
.pi/model/plan/06-prompt-optimization/drafts.feature:141
Source: .pi/model/prompt-optimization.allium · .pi/model/event-model/loyly/pi_harness/event_model.clj
rule MeasureInstructionCandidate {
    when: IndependentBuilderInstructionMetricReturned(
        orc,
        candidate,
        production_prompt,
        score,
        evidence
    )
    requires: candidate.status = proposed
    requires: (candidate.instruction.purpose = fresh_generation and production_prompt.role = slice_builder) or
              (candidate.instruction.purpose = verification_repair and production_prompt.role = repair_builder)
    requires: production_prompt.task_instruction_digest = candidate.instruction.text_digest
    requires: builder_host_transported_production_prompt_unchanged(production_prompt.digest)
    requires: purpose_specific_independent_measurement(
        candidate.instruction.purpose,
        evidence
    )
    requires: evidence_includes_fresh_builder_gate_and_complete_black_box_grade(evidence)
    ensures: candidate.status = measured
    ensures: candidate.production_prompt_digest = production_prompt.digest
    ensures: candidate.independent_score = score
    ensures: candidate.metric_evidence = evidence
}
